Think: "A-chief (leader) achieves things." ### 2. acquire (v.) - Definition: to come to own or possess something, often through effort - תרגום: לרכוש, לקנות, להשיג - Example 1: Over the years, the museum acquired a vast collection of rare paintings. - Example 2: Children acquire language skills naturally in their early years. - Synonyms: obtain, gain, procure - Antonyms: lose, forfeit - 💡 Memory tip: Think "a-cure" – you acquire the cure. ### 3. analyze (v.) - Definition: to examine something in detail in order to understand it - תרגום: לנתח - Example 1: Scientists must analyze the data carefully before reaching a conclusion. - Example 2: The teacher asked her students to analyze the poem's structure. - Synonyms: examine, investigate, study - Antonyms: synthesize, combine - 💡 Memory tip: "Anal-ysis" – looking at the small parts of something. ### 4. approach (v.) - Definition: to come near to; to begin to deal with something - תרגום: להתקרב אל; לגשת אל (נושא) - Example 1: As winter approaches, the days become shorter. - Example 2: We need a new way to approach this problem. - Synonyms: near, tackle, address - Antonyms: retreat, avoid ### 5. argue (v.) - Definition: to give reasons for or against something; to disagree verbally - תרגום: לטעון; להתווכח - Example 1: Many economists argue that inflation will rise next year. - Example 2: The couple argued about money for hours. - Synonyms: claim, contend, debate, quarrel - Antonyms: agree, concur ### 6. assume (v.) - Definition: to believe something is true without proof; to take on a role or responsibility - תרגום: להניח; לקבל על עצמו (תפקיד) - Example 1: I assumed you were coming to the meeting. - Example 2: She will assume the role of director next month. - Synonyms: presume, suppose, undertake - Antonyms: doubt, question ### 7. attempt (v.) - Definition: to make an effort to do something - תרגום: לנסות, לעשות מאמץ - Example 1: He attempted to climb the mountain but had to turn back. - Example 2: The students will attempt the final exam tomorrow. - Synonyms: try, endeavor, strive - Antonyms: give up, abandon ### 8. avoid (v.) - Definition: to stay away from; to prevent something from happening - תרגום: להימנע מ- - Example 1: You should avoid junk food if you want to stay healthy. - Example 2: The driver swerved to avoid the dog. - Synonyms: evade, escape, dodge - Antonyms: confront, face, encounter ### 9. believe (v.) - Definition: to accept as true; to have faith in - תרגום: להאמין - Example 1: Scientists do not believe that theory is supported by evidence. - Example 2: She believes in the power of education. - Synonyms: trust, accept, think - Antonyms: doubt, disbelieve, reject ### 10. create (v.) - Definition: to bring something into existence; to produce - תרגום: ליצור, לברוא - Example 1: The artist created a masterpiece in just three days. - Example 2: New technology is creating jobs in many industries. - Synonyms: produce, generate, form, make - Antonyms: destroy, demolish ### 11. decide (v.) - Definition: to make a choice after thinking - תרגום: להחליט - Example 1: We haven't decided where to go on vacation yet. - Example 2: The judge will decide the case next week. - Synonyms: determine, choose, resolve - Antonyms: hesitate, waver ### 12. describe (v.) - Definition: to say what someone or something is like - תרגום: לתאר - Example 1: Can you describe the man you saw? - Example 2: The article describes how the disease spreads. - Synonyms: portray, depict, explain - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) ### 13. develop (v.) - Definition: to grow or cause to grow and become more advanced - תרגום: לפתח, להתפתח - Example 1: The country has developed rapidly over the past decade. - Example 2: She developed a new method for testing water quality. - Synonyms: grow, evolve, advance, progress - Antonyms: regress, decline, deteriorate ### 14. discover (v.) - Definition: to find something new, especially a place, fact, or phenomenon - תרגום: לגלות - Example 1: Columbus is said to have discovered America in 1492. - Example 2: Researchers discovered a new species of fish in the deep ocean. - Synonyms: find, uncover, reveal, detect - Antonyms: hide, conceal, overlook ### 15. encourage (v.) - De

Example 2: Researchers discovered a new species of fish in the deep ocean. - Synonyms: find, uncover, reveal, detect - Antonyms: hide, conceal, overlook ### 15. encourage (v.) - Definition: to give someone support, confidence, or hope - תרגום: לעודד - Example 1: My parents always encouraged me to read. - Example 2: These rewards are designed to encourage good behavior. - Synonyms: motivate, inspire, support - Antonyms: discourage, dissuade ### 16. establish (v.) - Definition: to set up or create something that is meant to last - תרגום: לייסד, לבסס - Example 1: The university was established in 1925. - Example 2: The company has established a strong reputation in the field. - Synonyms: found, create, institute - Antonyms: abolish, dissolve ### 17. exist (v.) - Definition: to be present in the real world; to live - תרגום: להתקיים, להיות קיים - Example 1: Many rare species still exist in the Amazon rainforest. - Example 2: The theory suggests that parallel universes may exist. - Synonyms: be, live, remain - Antonyms: vanish, cease ### 18. expect (v.) - Definition: to believe something will happen - תרגום: לצפות, לחכות ל- - Example 1: We expect the rain to stop by evening. - Example 2: She didn't expect such a warm welcome. - Synonyms: anticipate, predict, foresee - Antonyms: be surprised by ### 19. explain (v.) - Definition: to make something clear by describing it - תרגום: להסביר - Example 1: Could you explain the rules of the game? - Example 2: He explained why he was late. - Synonyms: clarify, illustrate, describe - Antonyms: confuse, mystify ### 20. explore (v.) - Definition: to travel through a place to learn about it; to examine an idea - תרגום: לחקור, לתור - Example 1: The team set out to explore the unknown cave. - Example 2: The book explores the question of free will. - Synonyms: investigate, examine, survey - Antonyms: ignore, overlook ### 21. grow (v.) - Definition: to become larger or develop - תרגום: לגדול, לצמוח - Example 1: The plant grew three inches in one week. - Example 2: The company has grown rapidly since 2020. - Synonyms: increase, expand, develop - Antonyms: shrink, decline ### 22. happen (v.) - Definition: to take place; to occur - תרגום: לקרות, להתרחש - Example 1: Nothing unusual happened yesterday. - Example 2: Can you tell me what happened at the meeting? - Synonyms: occur, take place, arise - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) ### 23. improve (v.) - Definition: to make or become better - תרגום: לשפר, להשתפר - Example 1: Practice will help you improve your English. - Example 2: The weather should improve tomorrow. - Synonyms: enhance, upgrade, refine - Antonyms: worsen, deteriorate ### 24. include (v.) - Definition: to have as part of a whole - תרגום: לכלול - Example 1: The price includes breakfast. - Example 2: The report includes several important recommendations. - Synonyms: contain, comprise, incorporate - Antonyms: exclude, omit ### 25. increase (v.) - Definition: to become greater in number or amount - תרגום: להגדיל, לעלות - Example 1: The population of the city has increased sharply. - Example 2: Exercise increases your energy levels. - Synonyms: rise, grow, expand - Antonyms: decrease, reduce, diminish ### 26. learn (v.) - Definition: to gain knowledge or skill - תרגום: ללמוד - Example 1: Children learn languages more easily than adults. - Example 2: I learned about the news this morning. - Synonyms: study, master, acquire - Antonyms: forget, unlearn ### 27. occur (v.) - Definition: to happen, especially without being planned - תרגום: לקרות, להתרחש (פורמלי יותר) - Example 1: The accident occurred at 3 a.m. - Example 2: Earthquakes often occur along fault lines. - Synonyms: happen, take place, arise - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) - 💡 Memory tip: More formal/academic than "happen" – use in reading comprehension texts. ### 28. prove (v.) - Definition: to show that something is true with evidence - תרגום: להוכיח - Example 1: The test proved that the water was safe to drink. - Example 2: Can you prove your claim? - Synonyms: demonstrate, confirm, verify - Antonyms: disprove, refute ### 29. recognize (v.) - Definition: to know someone or something because you have seen them before; to accept as true - תרגום: לזהות; להכיר ב- - Example 1: I didn't recognize him with his new haircut. - Example 2: The company recognized her hard work with a promotion. - Synonyms: identify, acknowledge - Antonyms: ignore, overlook ### 30. suggest (v.) - Definition: to propose an idea; to indicate something without saying it directly - תרגום: להציע; לרמוז - Example 1: I suggest that we meet at 7 p.m. - Example 2: The results suggest that the treatment is effective. - Synonyms: propose, recommend, imply - Antonyms: demand, insist --- ## Section B: Nouns (שמות עצם) – 40 מילים דוגמה ### 31. ability (n.) - Definition: the power or skill to do something - תרגום: יכולת, כישרון - Example: She has the ability to solve complex problems quickly. - Synonyms: capability, skill, talent - Antonyms: inability, incompetence ### 32. advantage (n.) - Definition: a benefit or favorable position - תרגום: יתרון - Example: Speaking two languages can be a great advantage in business. - Synonyms: benefit, asset, strength - Antonyms: disadvantage, drawback ### 33. attempt (n.) - Definition: an effort to do something - תרגום: ניסיון, מאמץ - Example: This is my third attempt to pass the test. - Synonyms: effort, try, endeavor - Antonyms: abandonment ### 34. behavior (n.) - Definition: the way a person or animal acts - תרגום: התנהגות - Example: The teacher praised the students' behavior during the trip. - Synonyms: conduct, manner, actions ### 35. benefit (n.) - Definition: an advantage or gain - תרגום: תועלת, הטבה - Example: Regular exercise has many health benefits. - Synonyms: advantage, gain, profit - Antonyms: disadvantage, harm ### 36. challenge (n.) - Definition: a difficult task or situation - תרגום: אתגר - Example: Learning a new language is a real challenge. - Synonyms: difficulty, task, test - Antonyms: ease, simplicity ### 37. consequence (n.) - Definition: a result or effect of an action - תרגום: תוצאה, השלכה - Example: Climate change has serious consequences for our planet. - Synonyms: result, outcome, effect - Antonyms: cause - 💡 Memory tip: Usually refers to NEGATIVE results. Positive results = "benefits" or "outcomes." ### 38. decision (n.) - Definition: a choice made after thinking - תרגום: החלטה - Example: Making the right decision can change your life. - Synonyms: choice, judgment, resolution - Antonyms: indecision, hesitation ### 39. difference (n.) - Definition: a way in which things are not the same - תרגום: הבדל - Example: What is the difference between these two theories? - Synonyms: distinction, contrast - Antonyms: similarity, resemblance ### 40. effect (n.) - Definition: a result; the change caused by something - תרגום: השפעה, אפקט - Example: The new law had a positive effect on the economy. - Synonyms: result, outcome, consequence - Antonyms: cause, source - ⚠️ Don't confuse with: "affect" (verb, to influence) vs. "effect" (noun, a result). "The weather affects my mood" vs. "The effect of the weather is clear." ### 41. evidence (n.) - Definition: information that shows something is true - תרגום: הוכחה, ראיה - Example: There is strong evidence that the climate is changing. - Synonyms: proof, data, facts - Antonyms: refutation ### 42. example (n.) - Definition: something that shows what a thing is like - תרגום: דוגמה - Example: Can you give me an example of a chemical reaction? - Synonyms: instance, illustration, case ### 43. experience (n.) - Definition: knowledge or skill gained over time; an event that happens to someone - תרגום: ניסיון, חוויה - Example: She has ten years of experience as a nurse. - Synonyms: knowledge, expertise, event - Antonyms: inexperience ### 44. factor (n.) - Definition: one of several things that cause a result - תרגום: גורם - Example: Poor diet is a major factor in heart disease. - Synonyms: cause, element, reason ### 45. future (n.) - Definition: the time that will come - תרגום: עתיד - Example: Nobody knows what the future holds. - Antonyms: past, history ### 46. government (n.) - Definition: the group of people who rule a country - תרגום: ממשלה - Example: The government announced new tax reforms yesterday. - Synonyms: administration, regime, authorities ### 47. growth (n.) - Definition: the process of increasing or developing - תרגום: גידול, צמיחה - Example: Economic growth has slowed this year. - Synonyms: increase, development, expansion - Antonyms: decline, decrease, reduction ### 48. health (n.) - Definition: the condition of the body; being free from illness - תרגום: בריאות - Example: Smoking damages your health. - Antonyms: sickness, disease, illness ### 49. history (n.) - Definition: the study of past events; the past itself - תרגום: היסטוריה - Example: We should learn from the mistakes of history. - Antonyms: future ### 50. idea (n.) - Definition: a thought or suggestion; a concept - תרגום: רעיון - Example: She had a brilliant idea for the project. - Synonyms: thought, concept, notion, plan ### 51. industry (n.) - Definition: the production of goods and services - תרגום: תעשייה - Example: The technology industry creates millions of jobs. - Synonyms: business, sector, commerce ### 52. information (n.) - Definition: facts or knowledge about something - תרגום: מידע - Example: The internet provides a huge amount of information. - Synonyms: data, facts, knowledge - Antonyms: misinformation ### 53. issue (n.) - Definition: an important topic or problem - תרגום: נושא, בעיה - Example: Climate change is a major global issue. - Synonyms: problem, matter, concern ### 54. knowledge (n.) - Definition: information and understanding gained through learning - תרגום: ידע - Example: His knowledge of history impressed everyone. - Synonyms: understanding, awareness, expertise - Antonyms: ignorance ### 55. law (n.) - Definition: a rule made by government that must be obeyed - תרגום: חוק - Example: It is against the law to drive without a license. - Synonyms: rule, regulation, statute ### 56. level (n.) - Definition: the amount or quality of something - תרגום: רמה - Example: His level of English has improved dramatically. - Synonyms: degree, rank, stage ### 57. method (n.) - Definition: a way of doing something - תרגום: שיטה - Example: There are several methods for learning vocabulary. - Synonyms: way, approach, technique, system ### 58. opportunity (n.) - Definition: a good chance to do something - תרגום: הזדמנות - Example: Studying abroad is an excellent opportunity. - Synonyms: chance, occasion, possibility - Antonyms: obstacle ### 59. problem (n.) - Definition: a difficulty that needs to be solved - תרגום: בעיה - Example: The team is working to solve the problem. - Synonyms: difficulty, issue, challenge - Antonyms: solution ### 60. process (n.) - Definition: a series of steps to achieve a result - תרגום: תהליך - Example: Learning a language is a long process. - Synonyms: procedure, method, sequence ### 61. purpose (n.) - Definition: the reason for doing something - תרגום: מטרה, תכלית - Example: What is the purpose of this meeting? - Synonyms: aim, goal, reason, objective ### 62. quality (n.) - Definition: how good or bad something is - תרגום: איכות - Example: This restaurant is famous for the quality of its food. - Synonyms: standard, grade, value - Antonyms: (poor quality = defect, flaw) ### 63. reason (n.) - Definition: the cause or explanation for something - תרגום: סיבה - Example: The main reason for his absence was illness. - Synonyms: cause, explanation, motive - Antonyms: result, consequence ### 64. research (n.) - Definition: careful study to discover new facts - תרגום: מחקר - Example: Recent research shows that exercise improves mental health. - Synonyms: study, investigation, inquiry ### 65. result (n.) - Definition: something that happens because of something else - תרגום: תוצאה - Example: The result of the experiment was surprising. - Synonyms: outcome, effect, consequence - Antonyms: cause, source ### 66. skill (n.) - Definition: the ability to do something well - תרגום: מיומנות - Example: Communication skills are important in every job. - Synonyms: ability, expertise, talent - Antonyms: inability, clumsiness ### 67. society (n.) - Definition: people living together with shared laws and customs - תרגום: חברה - Example: Education plays a key role in modern society. - Synonyms: community, population, culture ### 68. solution (n.) - Definition: an answer to a problem - תרגום: פתרון - Example: We need a long-term solution to climate change. - Synonyms: answer, resolution, remedy - Antonyms: problem, dilemma ### 69. system (n.) - Definition: a set of parts working together - תרגום: מערכת - Example: The educational system needs reform. - Synonyms: structure, network, arrangement ### 70. theory (n.) - Definition: a formal explanation based on evidence - תרגום: תיאוריה - Example: Einstein's theory of relativity changed physics. - Synonyms: hypothesis, concept, principle --- ## Section C: Adjectives (שמות תואר) – 20 מילים דוגמה ### 71. accurate (adj.) - Definition: correct and without errors - תרגום: מדויק - Example: The data must be accurate to be useful. - Synonyms: precise, correct, exact - Antonyms: inaccurate, wrong, false ### 72. available (adj.) - Definition: ready to be used or obtained - תרגום: זמין, פנוי - Example: The information is available on our website. - Synonyms: accessible, obtainable, ready - Antonyms: unavailable, occupied ### 73. common (adj.) - Definition: happening often; shared by many - תרגום: נפוץ, משותף - Example: Headaches are a common symptom of stress. - Synonyms: usual, frequent, ordinary, shared - Antonyms: rare, unusual, unique ### 74. complex (adj.) - Definition: having many parts; difficult to understand - תרגום: מורכב - Example: The human brain is extremely complex. - Synonyms: complicated, intricate, elaborate - Antonyms: simple, basic, straightforward ### 75. crucial (adj.) - Definition: extremely important - תרגום: מכריע, חיוני - Example: Sleep is crucial for good health. - Synonyms: vital, essential, critical - Antonyms: unimportant, trivial ### 76. different (adj.) - Definition: not the same - תרגום: שונה - Example: The twins look alike but have very different personalities. - Synonyms: distinct, dissimilar, various - Antonyms: similar, identical, same ### 77. difficult (adj.) - Definition: not easy; requiring effort - תרגום: קשה, מורכב - Example: Learning a new language is difficult but rewarding. - Synonyms: hard, challenging, tough - Antonyms: easy, simple ### 78. effective (adj.) - Definition: producing the desired result - תרגום: יעיל, אפקטיבי - Example: The new medicine proved effective against the virus. - Synonyms: efficient, successful, productive - Antonyms: ineffective, useless ### 79. essential (adj.) - Definition: absolutely necessary - תרגום: חיוני, הכרחי - Example: Water is essential for life. - Synonyms: crucial, vital, necessary, fundamental - Antonyms: unnecessary, optional ### 80. important (adj.) - Definition: having great value or influence - תרגום: חשוב - Example: Family is the most important thing to me. - Synonyms: significant, crucial, major - Antonyms: unimportant, trivial, minor ### 81. likely (adj.) - Definition: probably going to happen - תרגום: סביר, צפוי - Example: It is likely to rain tomorrow. - Synonyms: probable, expected, possible - Antonyms: unlikely, improbable ### 82. obvious (adj.) - Definition: easy to see or understand - תרגום: ברור, גלוי - Example: The answer was obvious to everyone in the room. - Synonyms: clear, evident, apparent - Antonyms: unclear, hidden, obscure ### 83. possible (adj.) - Definition: able to happen or be done - תרגום: אפשרי - Example: It's possible to finish the work by Friday. - Synonyms: feasible, achievable - Antonyms: impossible, unattainable ### 84. practical (adj.) - Definition: useful in real life; sensible - תרגום: מעשי, שימושי - Example: We need a practical solution, not a theoretical one. - Synonyms: useful, realistic, sensible - Antonyms: theoretical, impractical ### 85. recent (adj.) - Definition: having happened a short time ago - תרגום: אחרון, מהזמן האחרון - Example: Recent studies suggest that coffee may be good for health. - Synonyms: new, fresh, latest - Antonyms: old, ancient, outdated ### 86. significant (adj.) - Definition: important or meaningful - תרגום: משמעותי, חשוב - Example: There has been a significant decrease in unemployment. - Synonyms: important, notable, considerable - Antonyms: insignificant, minor, trivial ### 87. similar (adj.) - Definition: almost the same - תרגום: דומה - Example: The two paintings are similar but not identical. - Synonyms: alike, comparable, like - Antonyms: different, dissimilar, opposite ### 88. successful (adj.) - Definition: achieving what was wanted - תרגום: מצליח - Example: She is a successful lawyer and author. - Synonyms: prosperous, triumphant, accomplished - Antonyms: unsuccessful, failed ### 89. true (adj.) - Definition: in agreement with facts; real - תרגום: נכון, אמיתי - Example: Is it true that you're moving to Canada? - Synonyms: real, accurate, correct - Antonyms: false, untrue, fake ### 90. useful (adj.) - Definition: helpful; producing good results - תרגום: שימושי, מועיל - Example: A dictionary is a useful tool for language learners. - Synonyms: helpful, practical, beneficial - Antonyms: useless, pointless --- ## Section D: Adverbs & Connectives (תארי פועל ומילות חיבור) – 10 מילים דוגמה ### 91. however (adv./conj.) - Definition: used to introduce a contrast - תרגום: אולם, עם זאת - Example: The plan sounds good. However, it will be expensive. - Synonyms: nevertheless, nonetheless, yet, but - 💡 Tip: Very common in academic writing to show contrast. ### 92. therefore (adv.) - Definition: for that reason; as a result - תרגום: לכן, לפיכך - Example: It was raining; therefore, we stayed inside. - Synonyms: thus, consequently, so, hence - 💡 Tip: Used to show logical conclusions in reading passages. ### 93. although (conj.) - Definition: despite the fact that - תרגום: אם כי, למרות ש- - Example: Although it was cold, we went for a walk. - Synonyms: though, even though, despite the fact that - Antonyms: because ### 94. moreover (adv.) - Definition: in addition; also - תרגום: יתרה מכך, בנוסף - Example: The plan is expensive. Moreover, it's risky. - Synonyms: furthermore, additionally, besides - 💡 Tip: Formal/academic style – a favorite in reading comprehension texts. ### 95. consequently (adv.) - Definition: as a result - תרגום: כתוצאה מכך - Example: She studied hard; consequently, she passed the exam. - Synonyms: therefore, thus, as a result - Antonyms: (shows cause/effect) ### 96. nevertheless (adv.) - Definition: in spite of what has just been said - תרגום: בכל זאת, אף על פי כן - Example: The team lost; nevertheless, they played well. - Synonyms: however, nonetheless, still - Antonyms: (shows contrast) ### 97. furthermore (adv.) - Definition: in addition - תרגום: יתר על כן - Example: The food was delicious. Furthermore, the service was excellent. - Synonyms: moreover, also, besides, additionally ### 98. despite (prep.) - Definition: without being affected by something - תרגום: למרות - Example: Despite the rain, the game continued. - Synonyms: in spite of, notwithstanding - 💡 Grammar note: "Despite" is followed by a noun or gerund, NOT a full clause. Use "although" before a clause: "Although it rained, …" vs. "Despite the rain, …" ### 99. whereas (conj.) - Definition: in contrast; while - תרגום: בעוד ש-, לעומת זאת - Example: He likes coffee, whereas his wife prefers tea. - Synonyms: while, on the other hand ### 100. eventually (adv.) - Definition: in the end; after a long time - תרגום: בסופו של דבר - Example: She eventually became a famous scientist. - Synonyms: finally, ultimately, at last - Antonyms: immediately - ⚠️ Common mistake: "Eventually" means "in the end" in English – NOT "possibly." ("possibly" = "maybe.") --- ## 🎯 Self-Check Quiz (10 שאלות מהירות) Test yourself! Choose the best word to complete each sentence: 1. "We need to ______ the data before drawing conclusions." → analyze / explore / describe 2. "He studied for years to ______ his dream." → avoid / achieve / learn 3. "The ______ of smoking on health is well documented." → advantage / effect / benefit 4. "Smoking has serious health ______." → results / consequences / solutions 5. "______ the rain, the concert took place outside." → Although / Despite / However 6. "The team practiced hard; ______, they won the championship." → however / consequently / whereas 7. "The dictionary is a very ______ tool for learners." → useful / accurate / essential 8. "The problem is extremely ______; it has many parts." → complex / simple / obvious 9. "We need to find a ______ solution to climate change." → theoretical / practical / possible 10. "She ______ finished her PhD after six years of research." → eventually / immediately / recently Answer Key: 1-analyze, 2-achieve, 3-effect, 4-consequences, 5-Despite, 6-consequently, 7-useful, 8-complex, 9-practical, 10-eventually --- ## נספח: פורמט flashcards אלקטרוני (לאנקי/Quizlet) קובץ CSV מיוצא בפורמט: word,part_of_speech,definition_english,translation_hebrew,example,synonym,antonym achieve,verb,to successfully reach a goal,להשיג,She worked hard to achieve her dream,accomplish,fail הקובץ יסופק בנפרד כחלק מחבילת הקורס. --- ## סיכום החבילה המלאה בחבילה המלאה יהיו 500 מילים בכל רמה × 4 רמות = 2000 מילים. פורמט זהה לחלוטין לסעיף הדוגמה הזה. המילים נבחרות באופן שיטתי לפי: - תדירות הופעה בטקסטים אקדמיים (בהתאם ל-Academic Word List) - רלוונטיות לנושאים הנפוצים במבחני אמירנ"ט (מדע, היסטוריה, חברה, כלכלה) - מבוססות על ניתוח דוגמאות ממבחני תרגול רשמיים של מאל"ו

Think: "A-chief (leader) achieves things." ### 2. acquire (v.) - Definition: to come to own or possess something, often through effort - תרגום: לרכוש, לקנות, להשיג - Example 1: Over the years, the museum acquired a vast collection of rare paintings. - Example 2: Children acquire language skills naturally in their early years. - Synonyms: obtain, gain, procure - Antonyms: lose, forfeit - 💡 Memory tip: Think "a-cure" – you acquire the cure. ### 3. analyze (v.) - Definition: to examine something in detail in order to understand it - תרגום: לנתח - Example 1: Scientists must analyze the data carefully before reaching a conclusion. - Example 2: The teacher asked her students to analyze the poem's structure. - Synonyms: examine, investigate, study - Antonyms: synthesize, combine - 💡 Memory tip: "Anal-ysis" – looking at the small parts of something. ### 4. approach (v.) - Definition: to come near to; to begin to deal with something - תרגום: להתקרב אל; לגשת אל (נושא) - Example 1: As winter approaches, the days become shorter. - Example 2: We need a new way to approach this problem. - Synonyms: near, tackle, address - Antonyms: retreat, avoid ### 5. argue (v.) - Definition: to give reasons for or against something; to disagree verbally - תרגום: לטעון; להתווכח - Example 1: Many economists argue that inflation will rise next year. - Example 2: The couple argued about money for hours. - Synonyms: claim, contend, debate, quarrel - Antonyms: agree, concur ### 6. assume (v.) - Definition: to believe something is true without proof; to take on a role or responsibility - תרגום: להניח; לקבל על עצמו (תפקיד) - Example 1: I assumed you were coming to the meeting. - Example 2: She will assume the role of director next month. - Synonyms: presume, suppose, undertake - Antonyms: doubt, question ### 7. attempt (v.) - Definition: to make an effort to do something - תרגום: לנסות, לעשות מאמץ - Example 1: He attempted to climb the mountain but had to turn back. - Example 2: The students will attempt the final exam tomorrow. - Synonyms: try, endeavor, strive - Antonyms: give up, abandon ### 8. avoid (v.) - Definition: to stay away from; to prevent something from happening - תרגום: להימנע מ- - Example 1: You should avoid junk food if you want to stay healthy. - Example 2: The driver swerved to avoid the dog. - Synonyms: evade, escape, dodge - Antonyms: confront, face, encounter ### 9. believe (v.) - Definition: to accept as true; to have faith in - תרגום: להאמין - Example 1: Scientists do not believe that theory is supported by evidence. - Example 2: She believes in the power of education. - Synonyms: trust, accept, think - Antonyms: doubt, disbelieve, reject ### 10. create (v.) - Definition: to bring something into existence; to produce - תרגום: ליצור, לברוא - Example 1: The artist created a masterpiece in just three days. - Example 2: New technology is creating jobs in many industries. - Synonyms: produce, generate, form, make - Antonyms: destroy, demolish ### 11. decide (v.) - Definition: to make a choice after thinking - תרגום: להחליט - Example 1: We haven't decided where to go on vacation yet. - Example 2: The judge will decide the case next week. - Synonyms: determine, choose, resolve - Antonyms: hesitate, waver ### 12. describe (v.) - Definition: to say what someone or something is like - תרגום: לתאר - Example 1: Can you describe the man you saw? - Example 2: The article describes how the disease spreads. - Synonyms: portray, depict, explain - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) ### 13. develop (v.) - Definition: to grow or cause to grow and become more advanced - תרגום: לפתח, להתפתח - Example 1: The country has developed rapidly over the past decade. - Example 2: She developed a new method for testing water quality. - Synonyms: grow, evolve, advance, progress - Antonyms: regress, decline, deteriorate ### 14. discover (v.) - Definition: to find something new, especially a place, fact, or phenomenon - תרגום: לגלות - Example 1: Columbus is said to have discovered America in 1492. - Example 2: Researchers discovered a new species of fish in the deep ocean. - Synonyms: find, uncover, reveal, detect - Antonyms: hide, conceal, overlook ### 15. encourage (v.) - Definition: to give someone support, confidence, or hope - תרגום: לעודד - Example 1: My parents always encouraged me to read. - Example 2: These rewards are designed to encourage good behavior. - Synonyms: motivate, inspire, support - Antonyms: discourage, dissuade ### 16. establish (v.) - Definition: to set up or create something that is meant to last - תרגום: לייסד, לבסס - Example 1: The university was established in 1925. - Example 2: The company has established a strong reputation in the field. - Synonyms: found, create, institute - Antonyms: abolish, dissolve ### 17. exist (v.) - Definition: to be present in the real world; to live - תרגום: להתקיים, להיות קיים - Example 1: Many rare species still exist in the Amazon rainforest. - Example 2: The theory suggests that parallel universes may exist. - Synonyms: be, live, remain - Antonyms: vanish, cease ### 18. expect (v.) - Definition: to believe something will happen - תרגום: לצפות, לחכות ל- - Example 1: We expect the rain to stop by evening. - Example 2: She didn't expect such a warm welcome. - Synonyms: anticipate, predict, foresee - Antonyms: be surprised by ### 19. explain (v.) - Definition: to make something clear by describing it - תרגום: להסביר - Example 1: Could you explain the rules of the game? - Example 2: He explained why he was late. - Synonyms: clarify, illustrate, describe - Antonyms: confuse, mystify ### 20. explore (v.) - Definition: to travel through a place to learn about it; to examine an idea - תרגום: לחקור, לתור - Example 1: The team set out to explore the unknown cave. - Example 2: The book explores the question of free will. - Synonyms: investigate, examine, survey - Antonyms: ignore, overlook ### 21. grow (v.) - Definition: to become larger or develop - תרגום: לגדול, לצמוח - Example 1: The plant grew three inches in one week. - Example 2: The company has grown rapidly since 2020. - Synonyms: increase, expand, develop - Antonyms: shrink, decline ### 22. happen (v.) - Definition: to take place; to occur - תרגום: לקרות, להתרחש - Example 1: Nothing unusual happened yesterday. - Example 2: Can you tell me what happened at the meeting? - Synonyms: occur, take place, arise - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) ### 23. improve (v.) - Definition: to make or become better - תרגום: לשפר, להשתפר - Example 1: Practice will help you improve your English. - Example 2: The weather should improve tomorrow. - Synonyms: enhance, upgrade, refine - Antonyms: worsen, deteriorate ### 24. include (v.) - Definition: to have as part of a whole - תרגום: לכלול - Example 1: The price includes breakfast. - Example 2: The report includes several important recommendations. - Synonyms: contain, comprise, incorporate - Antonyms: exclude, omit ### 25. increase (v.) - Definition: to become greater in number or amount - תרגום: להגדיל, לעלות - Example 1: The population of the city has increased sharply. - Example 2: Exercise increases your energy levels. - Synonyms: rise, grow, expand - Antonyms: decrease, reduce, diminish ### 26. learn (v.) - Definition: to gain knowledge or skill - תרגום: ללמוד - Example 1: Children learn languages more easily than adults. - Example 2: I learned about the news this morning. - Synonyms: study, master, acquire - Antonyms: forget, unlearn ### 27. occur (v.) - Definition: to happen, especially without being planned - תרגום: לקרות, להתרחש (פורמלי יותר) - Example 1: The accident occurred at 3 a.m. - Example 2: Earthquakes often occur along fault lines. - Synonyms: happen, take place, arise - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) - 💡 Memory tip: More formal/academic than "happen" – use in reading comprehension texts. ### 28. prove (v.) - Definition: to show that something is true with evidence - תרגום: להוכיח - Example 1: The test proved that the water was safe to drink. - Example 2: Can you prove your claim? - Synonyms: demonstrate, confirm, verify - Antonyms: disprove, refute ### 29. recognize (v.) - Definition: to know someone or something because you have seen them before; to accept as true - תרגום: לזהות; להכיר ב- - Example 1: I didn't recognize him with his new haircut. - Example 2: The company recognized her hard work with a promotion. - Synonyms: identify, acknowledge - Antonyms: ignore, overlook ### 30. suggest (v.) - Definition: to propose an idea; to indicate something without saying it directly - תרגום: להציע; לרמוז - Example 1: I suggest that we meet at 7 p.m. - Example 2: The results suggest that the treatment is effective. - Synonyms: propose, recommend, imply - Antonyms: demand, insist --- ## Section B: Nouns (שמות עצם) – 40 מילים דוגמה ### 31. ability (n.) - Definition: the power or skill to do something - תרגום: יכולת, כישרון - Example: She has the ability to solve complex problems quickly. - Synonyms: capability, skill, talent - Antonyms: inability, incompetence ### 32. advantage (n.) - Definition: a benefit or favorable position - תרגום: יתרון - Example: Speaking two languages can be a great advantage in business. - Synonyms: benefit, asset, strength - Antonyms: disadvantage, drawback ### 33. attempt (n.) - Definition: an effort to do something - תרגום: ניסיון, מאמץ - Example: This is my third attempt to pass the test. - Synonyms: effort, try, endeavor - Antonyms: abandonment ### 34. behavior (n.) - Definition: the way a person or animal acts - תרגום: התנהגות - Example: The teacher praised the students' behavior during the trip. - Synonyms: conduct, manner, actions ### 35. benefit (n.) - Definition: an advantage or gain - תרגום: תועלת, הטבה - Example: Regular exercise has many health benefits. - Synonyms: advantage, gain, profit - Antonyms: disadvantage, harm ### 36. challenge (n.) - Definition: a difficult task or situation - תרגום: אתגר - Example: Learning a new language is a real challenge. - Synonyms: difficulty, task, test - Antonyms: ease, simplicity ### 37. consequence (n.) - Definition: a result or effect of an action - תרגום: תוצאה, השלכה - Example: Climate change has serious consequences for our planet. - Synonyms: result, outcome, effect - Antonyms: cause - 💡 Memory tip: Usually refers to NEGATIVE results. Positive results = "benefits" or "outcomes." ### 38. decision (n.) - Definition: a choice made after thinking - תרגום: החלטה - Example: Making the right decision can change your life. - Synonyms: choice, judgment, resolution - Antonyms: indecision, hesitation ### 39. difference (n.) - Definition: a way in which things are not the same - תרגום: הבדל - Example: What is the difference between these two theories? - Synonyms: distinction, contrast - Antonyms: similarity, resemblance ### 40. effect (n.) - Definition: a result; the change caused by something - תרגום: השפעה, אפקט - Example: The new law had a positive effect on the economy. - Synonyms: result, outcome, consequence - Antonyms: cause, source - ⚠️ Don't confuse with: "affect" (verb, to influence) vs. "effect" (noun, a result). contentBlocks.body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## Vocabulary Package 1 – Basic Level (500 מילים) מבנה: 500 מילים בסיסיות במקצועיות קהל יעד: רמת יציאה בסיסית (3 יח"ל תיכון ומטה) מטרה: שליטה מלאה כתשתית ללמידה המשך --- ## 📋 מבנה החבילה | סוג מילה | מספר מילים | מתאים ל- | |---|---|---| | פעלים (Verbs) | 150 | פעולות יומיומיות | | שמות עצם (Nouns) | 200 | חפצים, מושגים | | תארים (Adjectives) | 100 | תיאורים | | תארי פועל ומילות קישור | 50 | מילים קושרות | | סה"כ | 500 | | ## 🎯 איך להשתמש בחבילה הזו? ### הגישה המומלצת – Spaced Repetition: 1. יום 1: למד 20-25 מילים חדשות 2. יום 2: חזור על 20-25 אלה + עוד 20-25 חדשות 3. יום 3: חזור על הכל + 20-25 חדשות 4. יום 7: בדוק את כל מה שלמדת השבוע ### מבנה כל מילה: - 📖 Definition - הגדרה באנגלית (חשוב להבין באנגלית, לא רק לתרגם) - 🇮🇱 תרגום - לעברית - 📝 Example 1 & 2 - שני משפטי דוגמה - 🔁 Synonyms - מילים נרדפות - ↔️ Antonyms - מילים נגדיות - 💡 Memory tip - טיפ לזכרון --- # 📘 חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) > טיפ: פעלים הם הלב של השפה. שליטה ב-150 פעלים הבסיסיים = יכולת להביע כמעט כל רעיון. ## 🟢 Section A1: פעלי יומיום בסיסיים (1-30) ### 1. be (v.) - Definition: to exist; to have a particular quality or state - תרגום: להיות - Example 1: I am a student at the university. - Example 2: The book is on the table. - Synonyms: exist, remain - Antonyms: (none - unique verb) - 💡 Memory tip: הפועל הכי בסיסי באנגלית. Forms: am/is/are/was/were/been. ### 2. have (v.) - Definition: to possess or own; to experience - תרגום: להיות ל-, להחזיק - Example 1: She has two brothers. - Example 2: We have a meeting at 3 PM. - Synonyms: possess, own - Antonyms: lack - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: have/has/had. משמש גם לזמני Perfect: "I have eaten". ### 3. do (v.) - Definition: to perform an action; to complete - תרגום: לעשות - Example 1: What do you do for work? - Example 2: She did her homework quickly. - Synonyms: perform, carry out - Antonyms: undo - 💡 Memory tip: עוזר הפועל הכי נפוץ לשאלות בהווה: "Do you like...?" ### 4. go (v.) - Definition: to move from one place to another - תרגום: ללכת, להגיע ל- - Example 1: I go to school every day. - Example 2: They went to Paris last summer. - Synonyms: travel, move, head - Antonyms: stay, remain, come - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: go/goes/went/gone. Past = "went" (לא "goed"). ### 5. come (v.) - Definition: to move toward a place; to arrive - תרגום: לבוא, להגיע - Example 1: Please come to my party on Friday. - Example 2: She came home late last night. - Synonyms: arrive, approach - Antonyms: go, leave - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: come/comes/came/come. "Come" נשאר גם בעבר השלישי. ### 6. see (v.) - Definition: to perceive with the eyes; to understand - תרגום: לראות; להבין - Example 1: I can see the mountains from my window. - Example 2: I see what you mean now. - Synonyms: look at, observe; understand - Antonyms: miss, ignore - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: see/sees/saw/seen. ### 7. look (v.) - Definition: to direct your eyes somewhere; to appear - תרגום: להסתכל; להיראות - Example 1: Look at the beautiful sunset! - Example 2: You look tired today. - Synonyms: glance, appear, seem - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל חשוב: see = תופס בעין (פסיבי), look = מכוון מבט (אקטיבי). ### 8. watch (v.) - Definition: to look at something for a period of time - תרגום: לצפות, לשמור על - Example 1: We watched a great movie last night. - Example 2: Please watch my bag while I use the bathroom. - Synonyms: observe, view - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: look at = רגע קצר; watch = לאורך זמן. ### 9. hear (v.) - Definition: to perceive with the ears - תרגום: לשמוע - Example 1: Did you hear that strange noise? - Example 2: I heard the news this morning. - Synonyms: listen, detect - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: hear = תופס באוזן; listen = מקשיב במכוון. Forms: hear/hears/heard/heard. ### 10. listen (v.) - Definition: to pay attention to sounds - תרגום: להקשיב, להאזין - Example 1: Listen carefully to the instructions. - Example 2: She loves to listen to classical music. - Synonyms: hear attentively - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: listen to (עם to). "Listen music" = שגוי. ### 11. say (v.) - Definition: to speak words; to state - תרגום: לומר - Example 1: What did you say? - Example 2: She said she was tired. - Synonyms: state, mention, declare - Antonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: say to someone. Forms: say/says/said/said. ### 12. tell (v.) - Definition: to communicate information to someone - תרגום: לספר, להגיד ל- - Example 1: Tell me about your day. - Example 2: He told her the truth. - Synonyms: inform, relate - Antonyms: hide, conceal - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: say = "say that" (ללא אובייקט מיידי); tell = "tell someone" (עם אובייקט). Forms: tell/tells/told/told. ### 13. speak (v.) - Definition: to use the voice to produce words - תרגום: לדבר - Example 1: Do you speak English? - Example 2: The president will speak at 8 PM. - Synonyms: talk, converse - Antonyms: be silent - 💡 Memory tip: speak a language. Forms: speak/speaks/spoke/spoken. ### 14. talk (v.) - Definition: to speak in conversatio

Antonyms: misunderstand - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: understand/understands/understood/understood. ### 18. learn (v.) - Definition: to acquire knowledge or skill - תרגום: ללמוד - Example 1: I want to learn how to cook. - Example 2: Children learn languages easily. - Synonyms: study, discover - Antonyms: forget, unlearn - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: learn = לרכוש ידע (תהליך פעיל); study = לחקור (בתהליך מסודר). ### 19. study (v.) - Definition: to examine carefully; to pursue academic learning - תרגום: ללמוד (במסגרת מסודרת), לחקור - Example 1: She studies biology at university. - Example 2: I need to study for the test tomorrow. - Synonyms: research, examine, learn - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: באנגלית אקדמית, study הוא פועל חשוב: "studies show that...". ### 20. teach (v.) - Definition: to give instruction to someone - תרגום: ללמד, להורות - Example 1: My mother teaches math. - Example 2: He taught me how to drive. - Synonyms: instruct, educate - Antonyms: learn (opposite direction) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: teach/teaches/taught/taught. ### 21. read (v.) - Definition: to look at written words and understand them - תרגום: לקרוא - Example 1: I read a book every week. - Example 2: She read the newspaper this morning. - Synonyms: study, peruse - Antonyms: (none direct) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: read/reads/read/read. בעבר, המילה כתובה זהה אבל הגיית "red"! ### 22. write (v.) - Definition: to make letters or words on a surface - תרגום: לכתוב - Example 1: Please write your name here. - Example 2: She wrote a long letter to her friend. - Synonyms: compose, record - Antonyms: erase, delete - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: write/writes/wrote/written. ### 23. eat (v.) - Definition: to consume food - תרגום: לאכול - Example 1: What do you want to eat for dinner? - Example 2: We ate pizza last night. - Synonyms: consume, devour - Antonyms: starve, fast - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: eat/eats/ate/eaten. ### 24. drink (v.) - Definition: to consume a liquid - תרגום: לשתות - Example 1: Drink plenty of water during exercise. - Example 2: He drank three cups of coffee. - Synonyms: sip, swallow - Antonyms: (none direct) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: drink/drinks/drank/drunk. ### 25. sleep (v.) - Definition: to rest with closed eyes in unconsciousness - תרגום: לישון - Example 1: I sleep for eight hours every night. - Example 2: The baby slept peacefully. - Synonyms: rest, slumber - Antonyms: wake up, be awake - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: sleep/sleeps/slept/slept. ### 26. wake (v.) / wake up - Definition: to stop sleeping - תרגום: להתעורר - Example 1: I usually wake up at 7 AM. - Example 2: The noise woke the baby. - Synonyms: arise, rise - Antonyms: sleep, fall asleep - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: wake/wakes/woke/woken. ### 27. work (v.) - Definition: to do a job; to function properly - תרגום: לעבוד; לפעול - Example 1: She works at a hospital. - Example 2: My computer doesn't work. - Synonyms: labor, function, operate - Antonyms: rest; break down - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "I have a lot of work." ### 28. play (v.) - Definition: to engage in a game; to perform music - תרגום: לשחק; לנגן - Example 1: The children are playing in the park. - Example 2: She plays the piano beautifully. - Synonyms: enjoy, perform - Antonyms: work - 💡 Memory tip: play a sport/game, play an instrument. ### 29. run (v.) - Definition: to move fast on foot; to operate - תרגום: לרוץ; להפעיל - Example 1: He runs five miles every morning. - Example 2: She runs her own business. - Synonyms: sprint, manage - Antonyms: walk; stop - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: run/runs/ran/run. ### 30. walk (v.) - Definition: to move on foot at a normal pace - תרגום: ללכת, לצעוד - Example 1: I walk to work every day. - Example 2: Let's walk in the park. - Synonyms: stroll, stride - Antonyms: run, ride - 💡 Memory tip: Regular verb: walk/walked/walked. --- ## 🟢 Section A2: פעלים יומיומיים נוספים (31-60) ### 31. sit (v.) - Definition: to rest on your bottom - תרגום: לשבת - Example 1: Please sit down. - Example 2: We sat by the fire all evening. - Synonyms: be seated - Antonyms: stand, rise - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: sit/sits/sat/sat. ### 32. stand (v.) - Definition: to be on your feet in an upright position - תרגום: לעמוד - Example 1: She stood by the window for hours. - Example 2: Please stand when the judge enters. - Synonyms: rise, be upright - Antonyms: sit, lie - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: stand/stands/stood/stood. ### 33. live (v.) - Definition: to be alive; to reside somewhere - תרגום: לחיות; לגור - Example 1: We live in Tel Aviv. - Example 2: My grandfather lived to be 95. - Synonyms: reside, exist, dwell - Antonyms: die - 💡 Memory tip: pronunciation: /lɪv/ (פועל) vs. /laɪv/ (live, תואר = חי). ### 34. die (v.) - Definition: to stop living - תרגום: למות - Example 1: The plant died because I forgot to water it. - Example 2: She's afraid to die alone. - Synonyms: pass away, perish - Antonyms: live, survive - 💡 Memory tip: -ing form: dying (not dieing!). ### 35. love (v.) - Definition: to have deep affection for - תרגום: לאהוב - Example 1: I love my family. - Example 2: She loves chocolate. - Synonyms: adore, cherish - Antonyms: hate, dislike - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "love is beautiful". ### 36. like (v.) - Definition: to find something enjoyable - תרגום: לאהוב (פחות חזק מ-love) - Example 1: I like your new dress. - Example 2: She likes playing tennis. - Synonyms: enjoy, fancy - Antonyms: dislike, hate - 💡 Memory tip: like + V-ing (like playing) או like + to V (like to play). ### 37. want (v.) - Definition: to desire something - תרגום: לרצות - Example 1: I want to go home. - Example 2: Do you want some coffee? - Synonyms: wish, desire - Antonyms: refuse - 💡 Memory tip: want + to V (want to go), want + noun (want a car). ### 38. need (v.) - Definition: to require something; to have a necessity - תרגום: להזדקק, להצטרך - Example 1: We need more time to finish this. - Example 2: The plant needs water. - Synonyms: require, demand - Antonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: want = רוצה (not necessarily needed); need = מצטרך. ### 39. give (v.) - Definition: to hand over; to provide - תרגום: לתת - Example 1: She gave me a book for my birthday. - Example 2: Please give me a moment. - Synonyms: hand, provide, donate - Antonyms: take, receive - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: give/gives/gave/given. ### 40. take (v.) - Definition: to remove; to accept; to carry - תרגום: לקחת - Example 1: Take this umbrella with you. - Example 2: I took the first bus. - Synonyms: grab, accept, carry - Antonyms: give, return - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: take/takes/took/taken. פועל רב-שימושי עם הרבה phrasal verbs. ### 41. get (v.) - Definition: to obtain; to become; to receive - תרגום: לקבל; להיעשות; להגיע - Example 1: I got a new phone yesterday. - Example 2: It's getting cold outside. - Synonyms: receive, obtain, become - Antonyms: lose, give - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: get/gets/got/gotten (American) / got (British). פועל הכי רב-שימושי באנגלית! ### 42. put (v.) - Definition: to place in a position - תרגום: לשים, להניח - Example 1: Put the book on the table. - Example 2: He put his shoes by the door. - Synonyms: place, set - Antonyms: remove, take away - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: put/puts/put/put. לא משתנה בעבר! ### 43. make (v.) - Definition: to create; to cause something to happen - תרגום: לעשות, ליצור - Example 1: She made a cake for the party. - Example 2: This news makes me happy. - Synonyms: create, produce, cause - Antonyms: destroy, break - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: make/makes/made/made. מבלבל עם "do" - make = ליצור, do = לבצע. ### 44. let (v.) - Definition: to allow; to permit - תרגום: לתת, לאפשר - Example 1: Let me help you. - Example 2: My parents let me stay out late. - Synonyms: allow, permit - Antonyms: forbid, prevent - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: let/lets/let/let. let someone V = מאפשר ל-X לעשות V. ### 45. help (v.) - Definition: to give support; to assist - תרגום: לעזור - Example 1: Can you help me with this? - Example 2: She helped her friend move. - Synonyms: assist, aid, support - Antonyms: hinder, obstruct - 💡 Memory tip: help someone [to] do something. ה-"to" אופציונלי! ### 46. try (v.) - Definition: to make an effort; to test something - aiRetrievalText: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## Vocabulary Package 1 – Basic Level (500 מילים) מבנה: 500 מילים בסיסיות במקצועיות קהל יעד: רמת יציאה בסיסית (3 יח"ל תיכון ומטה) מטרה: שליטה מלאה כתשתית ללמידה המשך --- ## 📋 מבנה החבילה | סוג מילה | מספר מילים | מתאים ל- | |---|---|---| | פעלים (Verbs) | 150 | פעולות יומיומיות | | שמות עצם (Nouns) | 200 | חפצים, מושגים | | תארים (Adjectives) | 100 | תיאורים | | תארי פועל ומילות קישור | 50 | מילים קושרות | | סה"כ | 500 | | ## 🎯 איך להשתמש בחבילה הזו? ### הגישה המומלצת – Spaced Repetition: 1. יום 1: למד 20-25 מילים חדשות 2. יום 2: חזור על 20-25 אלה + עוד 20-25 חדשות 3. יום 3: חזור על הכל + 20-25 חדשות 4. יום 7: בדוק את כל מה שלמדת השבוע ### מבנה כל מילה: - 📖 Definition - הגדרה באנגלית (חשוב להבין באנגלית, לא רק לתרגם) - 🇮🇱 תרגום - לעברית - 📝 Example 1 & 2 - שני משפטי דוגמה - 🔁 Synonyms - מילים נרדפות - ↔️ Antonyms - מילים נגדיות - 💡 Memory tip - טיפ לזכרון --- # 📘 חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) > טיפ: פעלים הם הלב של השפה. שליטה ב-150 פעלים הבסיסיים = יכולת להביע כמעט כל רעיון. ## 🟢 Section A1: פעלי יומיום בסיסיים (1-30) ### 1. be (v.) - Definition: to exist; to have a particular quality or state - תרגום: להיות - Example 1: I am a student at the university. - Example 2: The book is on the table. - Synonyms: exist, remain - Antonyms: (none - unique verb) - 💡 Memory tip: הפועל הכי בסיסי באנגלית. Forms: am/is/are/was/were/been. ### 2. have (v.) - Definition: to possess or own; to experience - תרגום: להיות ל-, להחזיק - Example 1: She has two brothers. - Example 2: We have a meeting at 3 PM. - Synonyms: possess, own - Antonyms: lack - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: have/has/had. משמש גם לזמני Perfect: "I have eaten". ### 3. do (v.) - Definition: to perform an action; to complete - תרגום: לעשות - Example 1: What do you do for work? - Example 2: She did her homework quickly. - Synonyms: perform, carry out - Antonyms: undo - 💡 Memory tip: עוזר הפועל הכי נפוץ לשאלות בהווה: "Do you like...?" ### 4. go (v.) - Definition: to move from one place to another - תרגום: ללכת, להגיע ל- - Example 1: I go to school every day. - Example 2: They went to Paris last summer. - Synonyms: travel, move, head - Antonyms: stay, remain, come - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: go/goes/went/gone. Past = "went" (לא "goed"). ### 5. come (v.) - Definition: to move toward a place; to arrive - תרגום: לבוא, להגיע - Example 1: Please come to my party on Friday. - Example 2: She came home late last night. - Synonyms: arrive, approach - Antonyms: go, leave - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: come/comes/came/come. "Come" נשאר גם בעבר השלישי. ### 6. see (v.) - Definition: to perceive with the eyes; to understand - תרגום: לראות; להבין - Example 1: I can see the mountains from my window. - Example 2: I see what you mean now. - Synonyms: look at, observe; understand - Antonyms: miss, ignore - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: see/sees/saw/seen. ### 7. look (v.) - Definition: to direct your eyes somewhere; to appear - תרגום: להסתכל; להיראות - Example 1: Look at the beautiful sunset! - Example 2: You look tired today. - Synonyms: glance, appear, seem - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל חשוב: see = תופס בעין (פסיבי), look = מכוון מבט (אקטיבי). ### 8. watch (v.) - Definition: to look at something for a period of time - תרגום: לצפות, לשמור על - Example 1: We watched a great movie last night. - Example 2: Please watch my bag while I use the bathroom. - Synonyms: observe, view - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: look at = רגע קצר; watch = לאורך זמן. ### 9. hear (v.) - Definition: to perceive with the ears - תרגום: לשמוע - Example 1: Did you hear that strange noise? - Example 2: I heard the news this morning. - Synonyms: listen, detect - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: hear = תופס באוזן; listen = מקשיב במכוון. "K" שקט! ### 17. understand (v.) - Definition: to grasp the meaning of something - תרגום: להבין - Example 1: I don't understand this question. - Example 2: She understood the lesson quickly. - Synonyms: comprehend, grasp - Antonyms: misunderstand - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: understand/understands/understood/understood. ### 18. learn (v.) - Definition: to acquire knowledge or skill - תרגום: ללמוד - Example 1: I want to learn how to cook. - Example 2: Children learn languages easily. - Synonyms: study, discover - Antonyms: forget, unlearn - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: learn = לרכוש ידע (תהליך פעיל); study = לחקור (בתהליך מסודר). ### 19. study (v.) - Example 1: My mother teaches math. - Example 2: He taught me how to drive. - Synonyms: instruct, educate - Antonyms: learn (opposite direction) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: teach/teaches/taught/taught. ### 21. read (v.) - Definition: to look at written words and understand them - תרגום: לקרוא - Example 1: I read a book every week. - Example 2: She read the newspaper this morning. - Synonyms: study, peruse - Antonyms: (none direct) - Example 2: She comes from a musical family. - Synonyms: relatives, kin - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: families. ### 159. mother (n.) / mom/mum - Definition: a female parent - תרגום: אם, אמא - Example 1: My mother is a doctor. - Example 2: Mom, can you help me? - Synonyms: mom (informal) - Antonyms: father - 💡 Memory tip: mom (אמריקאי) / mum (בריטי). ### 160. father (n.) / dad - Definition: a male parent - תרגום: אב, אבא - Example 1: My father works at a bank. - Example 2: Dad, where are you? - Synonyms: dad (informal) - Antonyms: mother - 💡 Memory tip: "dad" - צורה לא פורמלית, משפחתית. ### 161. parent (n.) - Definition: a father or mother - תרגום: הורה - Example 1: My parents live in Haifa. - Example 2: Being a parent is challenging. - Synonyms: mother/father - 💡 Memory tip: תמיד ברבים לפרטית - "my parents". ### 162. brother (n.) - Definition: a male sibling - תרגום: אח - Example 1: I have two brothers. - Example 2: My older brother is a teacher. - Synonyms: sibling - Antonyms: sister - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: brothers. ### 163. sister (n.) - Definition: a female sibling - תרגום: אחות - Example 1: My sister lives in Jerusalem. - Example 2: She's my younger sister. - Synonyms: sibling - Antonyms: brother - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: sisters. ### 164. son (n.) - Definition: a male child of parents - תרגום: בן - Example 1: Their son is studying medicine. - Example 2: She has one son and two daughters. - Synonyms: (none) - Antonyms: daughter - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: /sʌn/ - כמו "sun" (שמש). ### 165. daughter (n.) - Definition: a female child of parents - תרגום: בת - Example 1: Their daughter is getting married. - Example 2: I have three daughters. - Synonyms: (none) - Antonyms: son - 💡 Memory tip: "augh" = /ɔː/ (ה-gh שקטה!). ### 166. husband (n.) - Definition: a married man - תרגום: בעל - Example 1: Her husband is a lawyer. - Example 2: My husband cooks dinner. - Synonyms: spouse - Antonyms: wife - 💡 Memory tip: pronunciation: /ˈhʌzbənd/. ### 167. wife (n.) - Definition: a married woman - תרגום: אישה (נשואה) - Example 1: My wife loves gardening. - Example 2: His wife is a nurse. - Synonyms: spouse - Antonyms: husband - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: wives (לא "wifes"). ### 168. friend (n.) - Definition: a person you know and like - תרגום: חבר - Example 1: She is my best friend. - Example 2: I met a new friend at work. - Synonyms: buddy, companion, pal - Antonyms: enemy, stranger - 💡 Memory tip: make friends with X = להתיידד עם X. ### 169. neighbor (n.) / neighbour (British) - Definition: a person who lives near you - תרגום: שכן - Example 1: My neighbor is very friendly. - Example 2: The neighbors are having a party. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: איות אמריקאי: neighbor. בריטי: neighbour. ### 170. teacher (n.) - Definition: a person who teaches - תרגום: מורה - Example 1: My English teacher is excellent. - Example 2: She's a teacher at a high school. - Synonyms: instructor, educator - Antonyms: student - 💡 Memory tip: From "teach" + "-er" (who does the teaching). ### 171. student (n.) - Definition: a person who studies - תרגום: תלמיד, סטודנט - Example 1: She's a good student. - Example 2: The students are preparing for exams. - Synonyms: learner, pupil - Antonyms: teacher - 💡 Memory tip: בישראל: "סטודנט" = באוניברסיטה; "תלמיד" = בבית ספר. ### 172. doctor (n.) - Definition: a medical professional - תרגום: רופא - Example 1: Call the doctor if you feel worse. - Example 2: She wants to be a doctor. - Synonyms: physician, medic - 💡 Memory tip: קיצור: "Dr." = Doctor. ### 173. nurse (n.) - Definition: a person who cares for the sick - תרגום: אח/אחות (רפואית) - Example 1: The nurse gave him medicine. - Example 2: She works as a nurse at the hospital. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: "nurse a baby" = להאכיל תינוק. ### 174. boss (n.) - Definition: a person in charge - תרגום: בוס, מנהל - Example 1: My boss gave me a raise. - Example 2: He's the boss of the company. - Synonyms: manager, supervisor, chief - Antonyms: employee, worker - 💡 Memory tip: לא פורמלי. בעברית רשמית: manager. ### 175. worker (n.) - Definition: a person who works - תרגום: עובד, פועל - Example 1: The construction workers arrived early. - Example 2: She's a hard worker. - Synonyms: employee, laborer - Antonyms: boss (in some contexts) - 💡 Memory tip: work + -er = מי שעובד. ### 176. president (n.) - Definition: the leader of a country or organization - תרגום: נשיא - Example 1: The president gave a speech. - Example 2: Who is the president of Israel? - Synonyms: leader, chief - 💡 Memory tip: לפני שם: "President Biden". ### 177. king (n.) - Definition: a male royal ruler - תרגום: מלך - Example 1: The king lives in a palace. - Example 2: He's the king of England. - Synonyms: ruler, monarch - Antonyms: queen - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: kings. ### 178. queen (n.) - Definition: a female royal ruler - תרגום: מלכה - Example 1: The queen waved to the crowd. - Example 2: She lived like a queen. - Synonyms: ruler, monarch - Antonyms: king - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: queens. ### 179. stranger (n.) - Definition: a person you don't know - תרגום: זר, לא מוכר - Example 1: Don't talk to strangers. - Example 2: A stranger helped me find the way. - Synonyms: unknown person, outsider - Antonyms: friend, acquaintance - 💡 Memory tip: From "strange" (מוזר, לא מוכר). ### 180. guest (n.) - Definition: a visitor invited somewhere - תרגום: אורח - Example 1: We have guests tonight. - Example 2: Please treat our guest well. - Synonyms: visitor - Antonyms: host - 💡 Memory tip: זהירות: guest ≠ guess (לנחש)! --- # 🏠 קטגוריה 2: מקומות ומיקומים (30 מילים) ### 181. place (n.) - Definition: a location or area - תרגום: מקום - Example 1: This is a nice place to relax. - Example 2: I've been to many places in Europe. - Synonyms: location, spot, area - 💡 Memory tip: כללי מאוד - שימוש רב-תכליתי. ### 182. home (n.) - Definition: the place where you live - תרגום: בית (המקום, הרגש) - Example 1: I'm going home. - Example 2: There's no place like home. - Synonyms: house, residence - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: home = בית כרגש/מושג; house = בית כמבנה פיזי. ### 183. house (n.) - Definition: a building where people live - תרגום: בית (מבנה) - Example 1: They bought a new house. - Example 2: The house has three bedrooms. - Synonyms: building, residence - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: houses (הגייה: /ˈhaʊzɪz/). ### 184. apartment (n.) / flat (British) - Definition: a home in a large building - תרגום: דירה - Example 1: I live in a small apartment. - Example 2: My apartment is on the third floor. - Synonyms: flat (British) - 💡 Memory tip: אמריקאי: apartment. בריטי: flat. ### 185. room (n.) - Definition: a part of a building - תרגום: חדר; מקום - Example 1: My room is upstairs. - Example 2: There's no room for us all in the car. - Synonyms: space, chamber - 💡 Memory tip: גם "space" - "is there room for me?". ### 186. kitchen (n.) - Definition: the room where you cook - תרגום: מטבח - Example 1: She's in the kitchen. - Example 2: Our kitchen is small but modern. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: "kitchen" = place where you "catch" food to cook (עזר לזכור). ### 187. bedroom (n.) - Definition: a room for sleeping - תרגום: חדר שינה - Example 1: The bedroom is painted blue. - Example 2: I have my own bedroom. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: bed + room = bedroom. ### 188. bathroom (n.) - Definition: a room with a toilet/shower - תרגום: חדר אמבטיה, שירותים - Example 1: Where's the bathroom? - Example 2: The bathroom needs cleaning. - Synonyms: washroom, restroom (American) - 💡 Memory tip: bath + room = bathroom. ### 189. garden (n.) - Definition: an area of land with plants - תרגום: גינה - Example 1: We have a small garden behind the house. - Example 2: She's working in the garden. - Synonyms: yard (American) - 💡 Memory tip: "Kindergarten" = גן ילדים (מגרמנית). ### 190. city (n.) - Definition: a large town - תרגום: עיר - Example 1: Tel Aviv is a big city. - Example 2: She loves living in the city. - Synonyms: metropolis, urban area - Antonyms: village, country - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: cities. ### 191. town (n.) - Definition: a small to medium-sized city - תרגום: עיירה - Example 1: It's a quiet town. - Example 2: The town has only one supermarket. - Synonyms: municipality - Antonyms: village (smaller), city (larger) - 💡 Memory tip: קטן יותר מ-city, גדול יותר מ-village. ### 192. village (n.) - Definition: a small community in the countryside - תרגום: כפר - Example 1: She grew up in a small village. - Example 2: The village has only 200 people. - Synonyms: hamlet - Antonyms: city - 💡 Memory tip: זעיר יותר מ-town. ### 193. country (n.) - Definition: a nation; rural area - תרגום: מדינה; אזור כפרי - Example 1: Israel is a small country. - Example 2: They live in the country. - Synonyms: nation, rural area - Antonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים! "my country" = המדינה שלי; "the country" = האזור הכפרי. ### 194. world (n.) - Definition: the planet Earth; all people - תרגום: עולם - Example 1: The world is changing fast. - Example 2: People all over the world celebrate New Year. - Synonyms: earth, globe - 💡 Memory tip: "world" = מצב הדברים + מקום פיזי. ### 195. street (n.) - Definition: a road in a town/city - תרגום: רחוב - Example 1: I live on a quiet street. - Example 2: Cross the street carefully. - Synonyms: road, avenue - 💡 Memory tip: במכתבים: "Main Street". ### 196. road (n.) - Definition: a paved way for vehicles - תרגום: דרך, כביש - Example 1: The road is closed due to construction. - Example 2: We drove along the coastal road. - Synonyms: highway, street - 💡 Memory tip: יותר כללי מ-street (גם בין ערים). ### 197. park (n.) - Definition: a public area with trees and grass - תרגום: פארק, גן ציבורי - Example 1: Let's go for a walk in the park. - Example 2: The park is full of children. - Synonyms: garden,

contentBlocks.body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ג': 100 תארים (Adjectives) מבנה: 100 תארים בסיסיים מחולקים ל-5 קטגוריות תיאור --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. גודל ומידה (351-370) - 20 מילים 2. תכונות אדם (371-395) - 25 מילים 3. רגשות ומצבים (396-415) - 20 מילים 4. זמן וגיל (416-425) - 10 מילים 5. תיאור איכותי (426-450) - 25 מילים --- # 📏 קטגוריה 1: גודל ומידה (20 מילים) ### 351. big (adj.) - Definition: large in size - תרגום: גדול - Example 1: They live in a big house. - Example 2: She has a big smile. - Synonyms: large, huge, enormous - Antonyms: small, little - 💡 Memory tip: bigger, biggest - comparative/superlative. ### 352. small (adj.) - Definition: little in size - תרגום: קטן - Example 1: This is a small room. - Example 2: I have a small dog. - Synonyms: little, tiny - Antonyms: big, large - 💡 Memory tip: smaller, smallest. ### 353. large (adj.) - Definition: big in size - תרגום: גדול (פורמלי יותר) - Example 1: We need a large table. - Example 2: A large crowd gathered. - Synonyms: big, huge - Antonyms: small - 💡 Memory tip: large פורמלי יותר מ-big. ### 354. huge (adj.) - Definition: very big - תרגום: עצום, ענק - Example 1: The elephant is huge. - Example 2: That's a huge problem. - Synonyms: enormous, massive, gigantic - Antonyms: tiny, small - 💡 Memory tip: חזק יותר מ-"big" או "large". ### 355. tiny (adj.) - Definition: extremely small - תרגום: זעיר - Example 1: She has a tiny puppy. - Example 2: Only a tiny amount is needed. - Synonyms: small, little, minute - Antonyms: huge, enormous - 💡 Memory tip: קטן במיוחד. ### 356. tall (adj.) - Definition: of great height - תרגום: גבוה (אדם/עץ) - Example 1: He is very tall. - Example 2: The tall tree gives nice shade. - Synonyms: high - Antonyms: short - 💡 Memory tip: tall לאנשים/עצים. high למקומות/מחיר. ### 357. short (adj.) - Definition: small in height; brief - תרגום: נמוך; קצר - Example 1: She is short. - Example 2: It was a short trip. - Synonyms: little (height); brief (time) - Antonyms: tall; long - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: גובה או משך זמן. ### 358. high (adj.) - Definition: at a great height; significant - תרגום: גבוה (מקום, מחיר) - Example 1: The mountain is very high. - Example 2: The price is too high. - Synonyms: tall, elevated - Antonyms: low - 💡 Memory tip: high למיקום/מחיר; tall לאנשים. ### 359. low (adj.) - Definition: not high; below average - תרגום: נמוך - Example 1: The ceiling is low. - Example 2: Prices are low today. - Synonyms: below (average), little - Antonyms: high - 💡 Memory tip: אנטונים של high. ### 360. long (adj.) - Definition: of great length; lasting a long time - תרגום: ארוך - Example 1: She has long hair. - Example 2: It was a long day. - Synonyms: lengthy - Antonyms: short - 💡 Memory tip: גם פיזי וגם זמני. ### 361. wide (adj.) - Definition: extending far from side to side - תרגום: רחב - Example 1: The road is very wide. - Example 2: She has a wide smile. - Synonyms: broad - Antonyms: narrow - 💡 Memory tip: wide open = פתוח לרווחה. ### 362. narrow (adj.) - Definition: not wide - תרגום: צר - Example 1: The narrow path winds through the forest. - Example 2: The door is too narrow for this furniture. - Synonyms: thin, slim - Antonyms: wide, broad - 💡 Memory tip: Narrow = not wide. ### 363. thick (adj.) - Definition: large in width between opposite surfaces - תרגום: עבה - Example 1: This book is very thick. - Example 2: She has thick hair. - Synonyms: wide, dense - Antonyms: thin - 💡 Memory tip: רעיון של "עובי". ### 364. thin (adj.) - Definition: not thick; slim - תרגום: דק; רזה - Example 1: The paper is too thin. - Example 2: He's tall and thin. - Synonyms: slim, slender - Antonyms: thick, fat - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: דק פיזית / רזה לאדם. ### 365. heavy (adj.) - Definition: weighing a lot - תרגום: כבד - Example 1: This box is heavy. - Example 2: We had a heavy meal. - Synonyms: weighty - Antonyms: light - 💡 Memory tip: גם מטפורי: "heavy traffic", "heavy rain". ### 366. light (adj.) - Definition: not heavy; pale (colors); bright - תרגום: קל; בהיר - Example 1: My bag is very light. - Example 2: She wore a light blue dress. - Synonyms: weightless; pale; bright - Antonyms: heavy; dark - 💡 Memory tip: 3 מובנים: לא כבד / בהיר / מואר. ### 367. full (adj.) - Definition: containing as much as possible - תרגום: מלא - Example 1: The glass is full. - Example 2: I'm full - no more food for me. - Synonyms: filled - Antonyms: empty - 💡 Memory tip: full of X = מלא ב-X. ### 368. empty (adj.) - Definition: containing nothing - תרגום: ריק - Example 1: The room is empty. - Example 2: My wallet is empty. - Synonyms: bare, vacant - Antonyms: full - 💡 Memory tip: empty stomach = קיבה ריקה. ### 369. far (adj./adv.) - Definition: at a great distance - תרגום: רחוק - Example 1: My house is far from here. - Example 2: How far is the airport? - Synonyms: distant - Antonyms: near, close - 💡 Memory tip: Comparative: farther/further. ### 370. near (adj./prep.) - Definition: close in distance - תרגום: קרוב - Example 1: The bank is near my house. - Examp

- Synonyms: properly, effectively - Antonyms: badly, poorly - 💡 Memory tip: חריג! good (adj) → well (adv), לא "goodly". ### 457. hard (adv.) - Definition: with great effort - תרגום: קשה (במאמץ) - Example 1: She works hard. - Example 2: Try hard and you'll succeed. - Synonyms: with effort, vigorously - Antonyms: easily - 💡 Memory tip: "hard" עצמו הוא adv! לא "hardly". ### 458. hardly (adv.) - Definition: almost not; barely - תרגום: כמעט ולא, בקושי - Example 1: I hardly know him. - Example 2: She hardly eats anything. - Synonyms: barely, scarcely - Antonyms: frequently - 💡 Memory tip: חשוב! hard = קשה. hardly = כמעט ולא. שונים לגמרי! ### 459. almost (adv.) - Definition: very nearly - תרגום: כמעט - Example 1: I'm almost finished. - Example 2: It's almost 5 o'clock. - Synonyms: nearly - Antonyms: exactly - 💡 Memory tip: almost = almost there (כמעט שם). ### 460. nearly (adv.) - Definition: almost - תרגום: כמעט - Example 1: I nearly fell. - Example 2: She's nearly 18 years old. - Synonyms: almost - Antonyms: completely, exactly - 💡 Memory tip: almost ו-nearly = כמעט זהים. ### 461. completely (adv.) - Definition: entirely; totally - תרגום: לגמרי - Example 1: I completely agree with you. - Example 2: The work is completely finished. - Synonyms: totally, fully, entirely - Antonyms: partially - 💡 Memory tip: complete + -ly. ### 462. totally (adv.) - Definition: completely - תרגום: לגמרי, בסך הכל - Example 1: I totally forgot about the meeting. - Example 2: That's totally fine. - Synonyms: completely, entirely - Antonyms: partially - 💡 Memory tip: גם casual: "totally!" = "לגמרי!". ### 463. really (adv.) - Definition: very; actually - תרגום: באמת, מאוד - Example 1: I'm really tired. - Example 2: Is that really true? - Synonyms: very, actually, truly - Antonyms: slightly - 💡 Memory tip: תואר פועל נפוץ מאוד בדיבור יומיומי. ### 464. very (adv.) - Definition: to a high degree - תרגום: מאוד - Example 1: This is very important. - Example 2: She's very happy today. - Synonyms: extremely, really - Antonyms: slightly - 💡 Memory tip: לא להשתמש לפני comparatives ("very bigger" = שגוי!). ### 465. too (adv.) - Definition: more than needed; also - תרגום: יותר מדי; גם - Example 1: It's too hot to play outside. - Example 2: I want to come too. - Synonyms: excessively; also - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים! "too hot" = חם מדי. "me too" = אני גם. --- # ⏱️ קטגוריה 2: תארי פועל של זמן ותדירות (15 מילים) ### 466. always (adv.) - Definition: at all times - תרגום: תמיד - Example 1: She always arrives on time. - Example 2: I will always remember this day. - Synonyms: constantly, forever - Antonyms: never - 💡 Memory tip: 100% - הכי גבוה בתדירות. ### 467. usually (adv.) - Definition: most of the time - תרגום: בדרך כלל - Example 1: I usually take the bus to work. - Example 2: She usually drinks coffee in the morning. - Synonyms: generally, normally - Antonyms: rarely - 💡 Memory tip: כ-90% מהזמן. ### 468. often (adv.) - Definition: many times - תרגום: לעתים קרובות - Example 1: We often go to the beach. - Example 2: How often do you exercise? - Synonyms: frequently - Antonyms: rarely, seldom - 💡 Memory tip: כ-70% מהזמן. הגייה: /ˈɒfən/ (t שקטה). ### 469. sometimes (adv.) - Definition: occasionally - תרגום:
