never - 💡 Memory tip: כ-50% מהזמן. ### 470. rarely (adv.) - Definition: not often - תרגום: נדיר - Example 1: I rarely eat junk food. - Example 2: He rarely talks to strangers. - Synonyms: seldom, hardly ever - Antonyms: often, frequently - 💡 Memory tip: כ-10% מהזמן. ### 471. never (adv.) - Definition: not at any time - תרגום: אף פעם לא - Example 1: I never eat sushi. - Example 2: She has never been to Europe. - Synonyms: not ever - Antonyms: always - 💡 Memory tip: 0% - ההפך מ-always. ### 472. now (adv.) - Definition: at this moment - תרגום: עכשיו - Example 1: I'm busy right now. - Example 2: We need to leave now. - Synonyms: currently, at present - Antonyms: then, later - 💡 Memory tip: הרגע הנוכחי. ### 473. then (adv.) - Definition: at that time; next - תרגום: אז; אחר כך - Example 1: We ate, then we went to the movie. - Example 2: Back then, we didn't have phones. - Synonyms: next, afterward - Antonyms: now - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: "אז" (אז בעבר) / "אחר כך" (ברצף פעולות). ### 474. soon (adv.) - Definition: in a short time - תרגום: בקרוב - Example 1: I'll be there soon. - Example 2: She's coming home soon. - Synonyms: shortly - Antonyms: later, not yet - 💡 Memory tip: see you soon = נתראה בקרוב. ### 475. later (adv.) - Definition: after the present time - תרגום: מאוחר יותר - Example 1: I'll call you later. - Example 2: See you later! - Synonyms: afterward, subsequently - Antonyms: earlier, now - 💡 Memory tip: late + -er = יותר מאוחר. ### 476. already (adv.) - Definition: before now; sooner than expected - תרגום: כבר - Example 1: I've already finished my homework. - Example 2: She's already gone home. - Synonyms: previously, by now - Antonyms: not yet - 💡 Memory tip: מופיע עם Present Perfect: "have already V3". ### 477. yet (adv.) - Definition: up until now (in questions/negatives) - תרגום: עדיין - Example 1: Have you finished yet? - Example 2: I haven't seen that movie yet. - Synonyms: still, until now - 💡 Memory tip: yet - בשאלות ובשלילה; already - בחיובי. ### 478. still (adv.) - Definition: up to this time; yet continuing - תרגום: עדיין - Example 1: She's still waiting for her friend. - Example 2: Are you still hungry? - Synonyms: yet, continuously - 💡 Memory tip: גם תואר (still = שקט/יציב). ### 479. just (adv.) - Definition: very recently; only; exactly - תרגום: רק עכשיו; פשוט - Example 1: I just arrived. - Example 2: I just want to sleep. - Synonyms: recently; simply - 💡 Memory tip: מילה רבת-משמעויות. לרוב מתייחסת לזמן קרוב. ### 480. once (adv.) - Definition: one time - תרגום: פעם אחת - Example 1: I visited Paris once. - Example 2: She calls her grandmother once a week. - Synonyms: one time - Antonyms: never; many times - 💡 Memory tip: גם: once upon a time = היה היה (תחילת אגדה). --- # 🔗 קטגוריה 3: מילות קישור (Connectives) (15 מילים) ### 481. and (conj.) - Definition: connects similar ideas - תרגום: ו-, וגם - Example 1: Tom and I went to the store. - Example 2: She smiled and waved. - Synonyms: also, plus - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור הבסיסית ביותר - חיבור. ### 482. but (conj.) - Definition: connects contrasting ideas - תרגום: אבל - Example 1: I want to go, but I'm tired. - Example 2: She's smart but shy. - Synonyms: however, yet - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של ניגוד. ### 483. or (conj.) - Definition: presents alternatives - תרגום: או - Example 1: Would you like tea or coffee? - Example 2: We can go by car or bus. - Synonyms: either...or - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של בחירה. ### 484. so (conj./adv.) - Definition: for this reason; therefore - תרגום: לכן, אז - Example 1: It was raining, so we stayed home. - Example 2: I was tired, so I went to bed. - Synonyms: therefore, thus - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של תוצאה. ### 485. because (conj.) - Definition: for the reason that - תרגום: כי, בגלל ש- - Example 1: I'm happy because I passed the test. - Example 2: She's late because of traffic. - Synonyms: since, as - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של סיבה. ### 486. if (conj.) - Definition: in the event that - תרגום: אם - Example 1: If it rains, we'll stay inside. - Example 2: I'll help you if you need it. - Synonyms: in case, provided that - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של תנאי. ### 487. when (conj./adv.) - Definition: at what time; at the time that - תרגום: מתי; כאשר - Example 1: When do you finish work? - Example 2: Call me when you arrive. - Synonyms: at the time that - 💡 Memory tip: גם לשאלות (מתי?) וגם לקישור. ### 488. while (conj.) - Definition: during the time that - תרגום: בזמן ש-, כאשר - Example 1: I read while I waited. - Example 2: While she cooked, he cleaned. - Synonyms: during, as - 💡 Memory tip: שתי פעולות בו-זמנית. ### 489. before (prep./conj.) - Definition: at an earlier time than - תרגום: לפני - Example 1: Before we leave, let's eat. - Example 2: He arrived before noon. - Synonyms: earlier than, prior to - Antonyms: after - 💡 Memory tip: במילון של זמן: before. ### 490. after (prep./conj.) - Definition: at a later time than - תרגום: אחרי - Example 1: After dinner, we watched TV. - Example 2: I'll call you after I finish. - Synonyms: following, later than - Antonyms: before - 💡 Memory tip: אחרי (זמן / מיקום ברצף). ### 491. although (conj.) - Definition: in spite of; even though - תרגום: למרות ש- - Example 1: Although it was cold, we went hiking. - Example 2: She smiled although she was sad. - Synonyms: even though, despite the fact that - 💡 Memory tip: מילה פורמלית ל-"but"; יוצרת ניגוד. ### 492. however (adv.) - Definition: on the other hand - תרגום: עם זאת, אולם - Example 1: The plan is good. However, it's expensive. - Example 2: I wanted to go; however, I was too tired. - Synonyms: nevertheless, but - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-"but". משמש בתחילת משפט עם פסיק. ### 493. also (adv.) - Definition: in addition; too - תרגום: גם - Example 1: She's smart and also kind. - Example 2: I also want to come. - Synonyms: too, as well - 💡 Memory tip: also באמצע משפט; too בסוף. ### 494. both (det./pron.) - Definition: the two together - תרגום: שניהם - Example 1: Both of us are tired. - Example 2: I like both cats and dogs. - Synonyms: the two - Antonyms: neither - 💡 Memory tip: both X and Y = גם X וגם Y. ### 495. only (adv.) - Definition: nothing else; just - תרגום: רק - Example 1: I have only 10 minutes. - Example 2: Only John can help us. - Synonyms: just, merely - 💡 Memory tip: מגביל (limit). --- # 💎 קטגוריה 4: ביטויים חשובים (5 מילים) ### 496. yes (adv.) - Definition: a positive answer - תרגום: כן - Example 1: "Do you like it?" "Yes, I do." - Example 2: Yes, please! - Synonyms: yeah (casual), yep (very casual) - Antonyms: no - 💡 Memory tip: מילת האישור הבסיסית. ### 497. no (adv.) - Definition: a negative answer - תרגום: לא - Example 1: "Are you hungry?" "No, thanks." - Example 2: No, I disagree. - Synonyms: nope (casual) - Antonyms: yes - 💡 Memory tip: מילת השלילה הבסיסית. ### 498. maybe (adv.) - Definition: possibly; perhaps - תרגום: אולי - Example 1: Maybe I'll come to the party. - Example 2: Maybe it will rain tomorrow. - Synonyms: perhaps, possibly - 💡 Memory tip: may + be = אולי יהיה. ### 499. please (adv.) - Definition: used to make polite requests - תרגום: בבקשה - Example 1: Can you help me, please? - Example 2: Please close the door. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: מילה נימוסית חיונית! ### 500. thanks / thank you - Definition: words of gratitude - תרגום: תודה / תודה לך - Example 1: Thanks for your help! - Example 2: Thank you very much. - Synonyms: thanks a lot, many thanks - 💡 Memory tip: thanks - casual; thank you - formal. --- # 🎉 סיום חבילה 1 - Easy! ## 🏆 בריכות! סיימת את 500 המילים הראשונות של הקורס! ### סיכום חבילה 1: - ✅ חלק א': 150 פעלים - ✅ חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם - ✅ חלק ג': 100 תארים - ✅ חלק ד': 50 תארי פועל ומילות חיבור - 📊 סה"כ: 500 מילים ברמת Easy --- ## 🧠 כללי זהב לתארי פועל: ### 1. -ly Rule רוב תארי הפועל = תואר + -ly: - quick → quickly - slow → slowly - careful → carefully ### 2. תארי פועל חריגים - good → well (לא "goodly") - fast → fast (נשאר) - hard → hard (נשאר!) - hard (adv) = קשה, במאמץ - hardly = כמעט ולא (משמעות שונה!) ### 3. מיקום תדירות במשפט - לפני הפועל: "I always eat breakfast." - אחרי be: "She is always happy." - בתחילת משפט (חריג): "Sometimes I walk." ### 4. Connectives באקדמיה רמת פורמליות שונה: - יומיומי: but, so, because - פורמלי: however, therefore, since - אקדמי: nevertheless, consequently, owing to --- ## 🎯 תרגיל מסכם - חבילה 1 ### חלק א': תרגם לעברית 1. achieve _______________ 2. beautiful _______________ 3. frequently _______________ 4. although _______________ 5. improve _______________ ### חלק ב': תרגם לאנגלית 6. חשוב _______________ 7. לעולם לא _______________ 8. תמיד _______________ 9. למרות _______________ 10. משפחה _______________ ### חלק ג': השלם משפט 11. I ___ (always / never) eat breakfast - I love it. 12. I'm tired, ___ (but / so / and) I'll go to bed. 13. sooner than expected - תרגום: כבר - Example 1: I've already finished my homework. - Example 2: She's already gone home. - Synonyms: previously, by now - Antonyms: not yet - 💡 Memory tip: מופיע עם Present Perfect: "have already V3". ### 477. yet (adv.) - Definition: up until now (in questions/negatives) - תרגום: עדיין - Example 1: Have you finished yet? - Example 2: I haven't seen that movie yet. - Synonyms: still, until now - 💡 Memory tip: yet - בשאלות ובשלילה; only; exactly - תרגום: רק עכשיו; פשוט - Example 1: I just arrived. - Example 2: I just want to sleep. - Synonyms: recently; simply - 💡 Memory tip: מילה רבת-משמעויות. לרוב מתייחסת לזמן קרוב. ### 480. once (adv.) - Definition: one time - תרגום: פעם אחת - Example 1: I visited Paris once. - Example 2: She calls her grandmother once a week. - Synonyms: one time - Antonyms: never; many times - 💡 Memory tip: גם: once upon a time = היה היה (תחילת אגדה). --- # 🔗 קטגוריה 3: מילות קישור (Connectives) (15 מילים) ### 481. and (conj.) - Definition: connects similar ideas - תרגום: ו-, וגם - Example 1: Tom and I went to the store. - Example 2: She smiled and waved. - Synonyms: also, plus - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור הבסיסית ביותר - חיבור. ### 482. but (conj.) - Definition: connects contrasting ideas - תרגום: אבל - Example 1: I want to go, but I'm tired. - Example 2: She's smart but shy. - Synonyms: however, yet - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של ניגוד. ### 483. or (conj.) - Definition: presents alternatives - תרגום: או - Example 1: Would you like tea or coffee? - Example 2: We can go by car or bus. - Synonyms: either...or - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של בחירה. ### 484. so (conj./adv.) - Definition: for this reason; bullets: # חבילת אוצר מילים #2 – רמת Intermediate ## חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) - רמה בינונית מבנה: פעלים ברמה אקדמית בינונית - משמשים בטקסטים אינטלקטואליים ובמאמרים --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלי פעולה מתקדמים (501-530) - 30 מילים 2. פעלי מחשבה ואנליזה (531-560) - 30 מילים 3. פעלי תקשורת פורמלית (561-590) - 30 מילים 4. פעלי שינוי והתפתחות (591-620) - 30 מילים 5. פעלים אקדמיים (621-650) - 30 מילים --- # 🏃 קטגוריה 1: פעלי פעולה מתקדמים (30 מילים) ### 501. achieve (v.) - Definition: to successfully reach a goal - תרגום: להשיג - Example 1: She worked hard to achieve her dream. - Example 2: The team achieved great results. - Synonyms: accomplish, attain - Antonyms: fail, miss - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: achieve a goal/success/victory. ### 502. accomplish (v.) - Definition: to complete successfully - תרגום: להשיג, להשלים - Example 1: We accomplished all our tasks today. - Example 2: He accomplished a lot in his career. - Synonyms: achieve, complete - Antonyms: fail - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-achieve. ### 503. acquire (v.) - Definition: to gain or obtain - תרגום: לרכוש, להשיג - Example 1: The company acquired a new office. - Example 2: Children acquire language naturally. - Synonyms: obtain, gain - Antonyms: lose - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: acquire skills/knowledge. ### 504. obtain (v.) - Definition: to get something, often with effort - תרגום: להשיג, לקבל - Example 1: You need to obtain permission first. - Example 2: She obtained a degree in law. - Synonyms: acquire, get - Antonyms: lose - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-get. ### 505. gain (v.) - Definition: to get something useful - תרגום: לרכוש, להרוויח - Example 1: Exercise helps you gain strength. - Example 2: He gained valuable experience. - Synonyms: acquire, obtain - Antonyms: lose - 💡 Memory tip: gain weight/experience/knowledge. ### 506. provide (v.) - Definition: to give something needed - תרגום: לספק, לתת - Example 1: The school provides free lunch. - Example 2: Can you provide more information? - Synonyms: supply, give, offer - Antonyms: deny, withhold - 💡 Memory tip: provide X for/with Y. ### 507. supply (v.) - Definition: to provide what is needed - תרגום: לספק - Example 1: The company supplies parts to factories. - Example 2: They supply us with everything we need. - Synonyms: provide, give - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "supply and demand". ### 508. deliver (v.) - Definition: to bring something to a place - תרגום: לספק, להעביר - Example 1: We deliver pizza to your door. - Example 2: She delivered a great speech. - Synonyms: bring, transport, give - 💡 Memory tip: deliver a speech/presentation/package. ### 509. transport (v.) - Definition: to carry from one place to another - תרגום: להעביר, להוביל - Example 1: Trains transport passengers daily. - Example 2: The ship transports goods overseas. - Synonyms: carry, move, deliver - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: public transport. ### 510. produce (v.) - Definition: to make or create - תרגום: לייצר, לייצר - Example 1: This factory produces cars. - Example 2: The plant produces fruit every year. - Synonyms: make, create, manufacture - Antonyms: destroy - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: פועל /prəˈduːs/, שם עצם /ˈprɒdjuːs/. ### 511. create (v.) - Definition: to make something new - תרגום: ליצור - Example 1: She created a beautiful painting. - Example 2: We need to create a solution. - Synonyms: make, produce, build - Antonyms: destroy - 💡 Memory tip: create = יצירה מחדש; produce = ייצור כמותי. ### 512. design (v.) - Definition: to plan the look of something - תרגום: לעצב, לתכנן - Example 1: She designed the new logo. - Example 2: The architect designed the building. - Synonyms: plan, create - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "a beautiful design". ### 513. develop (v.) - Definition: to grow or improve - תרגום: לפתח - Example 1: Children develop quickly. - Example 2: The company developed a new product. - Synonyms: grow, create, advance - 💡 Memory tip: develop skills/products/relationships. ### 514. improve (v.) - Definition: to make or become better - תרגום: לשפר - Example 1: Practice helps you improve. - Example 2: We need to improve our performance. - Synonyms: enhance, better, upgrade - Antonyms: worsen - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: improve skills/quality/performance. ### 515. enhance (v.) - Definition: to improve the quality of - תרגום: לשפר, להעצים - Example 1: The software enhances the image. - Example 2: Music can enhance your mood. - Synonyms: improve, boost - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-improve. ### 516. encourage (v.) - Definition: to give support and confidence - תרגום: לעודד - Example 1: My parents encouraged me to study. - Example 2: The teacher encourages creativity. - Synonyms: support, motivate - Antonyms: discourage - 💡 Memory tip: encourage someone to V. ### 517. discourage (v.) - Definition: to make someone less confident - תרגום: להרתיע - Example 1: Don't let failure discourage you. - Example 2: The bad weather discouraged them. - Synonyms: deter, dishearten - Antonyms: encourage - 💡 Memory tip: dis- = הפוך של encourage. ### 518. recommend (v.) - Definition: to suggest something as good - תרגום: להמליץ - Example 1: I recommend this book. - Example 2: The doctor recommended rest. - Synonyms: suggest, advise - 💡 Memory tip: recommend + V-ing או recommend that + subjunctive. ### 519. suggest (v.) - Definition: to propose an idea - תרגום: להציע, לרמוז - Example 1: I suggest we leave early. - Example 2: The evidence suggests he's innocent. - Synonyms: propose, recommend, imply - 💡 Memory tip: גם "לרמוז": evidence suggests. ### 520. propose (v.) - Definition: to put forward an idea - תרגום: להציע - Example 1: She proposed a new plan. - Example 2: He proposed marriage to her. - Synonyms: suggest, offer - 💡 Memory tip: יותר פורמלי מ-suggest. גם: להציע נישואין. ### 521. offer (v.) - Definition: to present for acceptance - תרגום: להציע - Example 1: They offered me a job. - Example 2: Can I offer you some coffee? - Synonyms: provide, present - Antonyms: refuse - 💡 Memory tip: offer X to Y / offer to V. ### 522. refuse (v.) - Definition: to say no to something - תרגום: לסרב - Example 1: He refused to help me. - Example 2: She refused the invitation. - Synonyms: decline, reject - Antonyms: accept, agree - 💡 Memory tip: refuse to V = לסרב לעשות. ### 523. reject (v.) - Definition: to not accept - תרגום: לדחות - Example 1: The committee rejected the proposal. - Example 2: She rejected the offer. - Synonyms: refuse, decline, turn down - Antonyms: accept, approve - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-refuse; בהקשר החלטות. ### 524. approve (v.) - Definition: to accept as good; to give permission - תרגום: לאשר - Example 1: The boss approved the project. - Example 2: I don't approve of smoking. - Synonyms: accept, sanction - Antonyms: reject, disapprove - 💡 Memory tip: approve of X = לאשר/לחזק X. ### 525. request (v.) - Definition: to ask politely for - תרגום: לבקש - Example 1: She requested a glass of water. - Example 2: I request your attention. - Synonyms: ask, seek - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-ask. ### 526. demand (v.) - Definition: to ask forcefully - תרגום: לדרוש - Example 1: Workers demanded higher pay. - Example 2: The situation demands attention. - Synonyms: require, insist on - 💡 Memory tip: חזק יותר מ-request או ask. ### 527. require (v.) - Definition: to need - תרגום: לדרוש, להזדקק - Example 1: This job requires experience. - Example 2: Plants require water to grow. - Synonyms: need, demand - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-need. ### 528. prevent (v.) - Definition: to stop something from happening - תרגום: למנוע - Example 1: Exercise prevents disease. - Example 2: Rain prevented the game. - Synonyms: stop, block, avoid - Antonyms: allow, enable - 💡 Memory tip: prevent someone from V-ing. ### 529. cause (v.) - Definition: to make something happen - תרגום: לגרום - Example 1: Smoking causes cancer. - Example 2: The storm caused damage. - Synonyms: produce, result in - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "cause and effect". ### 530. affect (v.) - Definition: to have an effect on - תרגום: להשפיע על - Example 1: The news affected everyone. - Example 2: Stress affects your health. - Synonyms: influence, impact - 💡 Memory tip: affect (פועל) ≠ effect (שם עצם)! --- # 🧠 קטגוריה 2: פעלי מחשבה ואנליזה (30 מילים) ### 531. analyze (v.) - Definition: to examine in detail - תרגום: לנתח - Example 1: Scientists analyze data carefully. - Example 2: She analyzed the problem logically. - Synonyms: examine, study, investigate - 💡 Memory tip: גם analyse (בריטי). ### 532. examine (v.) - Definition: to inspect carefully - תרגום: לבדוק, לחקור - Example 1: The doctor examined the patient. - Example 2: Let's examine the evidence. - Synonyms: inspect, analyze, check - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-check. ### 533. investigate (v.) - Definition: to research carefully - תרגום: לחקור - Example 1: The police are investigating the crime. - Example 2: We need to investigate the cause. - Synonyms: research, examine, probe - 💡 Memory tip: קשור למשטרה ולחקירות מדעיות. ### 534. research (v.) - Definition: to study carefully - תרגום: לחקור - Example 1: I researched the topic for days. - Example 2: Scientists research new medicines. - Synonyms: study, investigate - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "scientific research". ### 535. observe (v.) - Definition: to watch carefully - תרגום: להתבונן, לצפות - Example 1: The children observed the butterflies. - Example 2: I observed a change in behavior. - Synonyms: watch, notice, witness - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-watch. ### 536. notice (v.) - Definition: to become aware of - תרגום: לשים לב - Example 1: Did you notice her new haircut? - Example 2: I noticed something strange. - Synonyms: observe, see, spot - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "a notice on the board". ### 537. realize (v.) - Definition: to become aware of; to make real - תרגום: להבין, לקלוט; להגשים - Example 1: I realized my mistake too late. - Example 2: She realized her dream. - Synonyms: understand, recognize; achieve - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים. הבריטי: realise. ### 538. recognize (v.) - Definition: to identify something known - תרגום: לזהות, להכיר - Example 1: I didn't recognize her with short hair. - Example 2: The school recognizes hard work. - Synonyms: identify, know - 💡 Memory tip: re- + -cognize (לדעת שוב). ### 539. identify (v.) - Definition: to establish the identity of - תרגום: לזהות - Example 1: Can you identify the suspect? - Example 2: We need to identify the problem. - Synonyms: recognize, determine - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-recognize. ### 540. determine (v.) - Definition: to decide or find out - תרגום: לקבוע, להחליט - Example 1: We need to determine the cause. - Example 2: She determined to succeed. - Synonyms: decide, establish - 💡 Memory tip: קשור ל-determination (נחישות). ### 541. consider (v.) - Definition: to think about carefully - תרגום: לשקול, לחשוב על - Example 1: Consider all your options. - Example 2: I consider him a friend. - Synonyms: think about, regard - 💡 Memory tip: consider + V-ing = שוקל לעשות. ### 542. assume (v.) - Definition: to believe without proof - תרגום: להניח - Example 1: I assume you're coming. - Example 2: Don't assume - ask! - Synonyms: presume, suppose - Antonyms: know, verify - 💡 Memory tip: הנחה ללא הוכחה. ### 543. suppose (v.) - Definition: to think likely; to assume - תרגום: להניח, לחשוב - Example 1: I suppose you're right. - Example 2: Suppose it rains, what will we do? - Synonyms: assume, think - 💡 Memory tip: I suppose so = אני מניח שכן. ### 544. doubt (v.) - Definition: to feel uncertain about - תרגום: להטיל ספק - Example 1: I doubt she'll come. - Example 2: He never doubted her honesty. - Synonyms: question, suspect - Antonyms: trust, believe - 💡 Memory tip: "b" silent! pronunciation: /daʊt/. ### 545. question (v.) - Definition: to ask about; to doubt - תרגום: לשאול; להטיל ספק - Example 1: The police questioned the witness. - Example 2: I question his motives. - Synonyms: ask, doubt - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם - שאלה. ### 546. compare (v.) - Definition: to examine similarities and differences - תרגום: להשוות - Example 1: Compare the two products. - Example 2: She compared her work to his. - Synonyms: contrast, examine - 💡 Memory tip: compare X to/with Y. ### 547. contrast (v.) - Definition: to show differences - תרגום: להשוות (בניגוד) - Example 1: Her calm contrasted with his anger. - Example 2: Contrast these two paintings. - Synonyms: differ, oppose - Antonyms: compare (for similarities) - 💡 Memory tip: הדגשת הבדלים. הגייה: פועל /kənˈtrɑːst/, שם עצם /ˈkɒntrɑːst/. ### 548. distinguish (v.) - Definition: to recognize differences - תרגום: להבחין - Example 1: Can you distinguish between these colors? - Example 2: It's hard to distinguish the two twins. - Synonyms: differentiate, tell apart - 💡 Memory tip: distinguish between X and Y. ### 549. define (v.) - Definition: to state the meaning of - תרגום: להגדיר - Example 1: Can you define that word? - Example 2: His success is hard to define. - Synonyms: explain, describe - 💡 Memory tip: מ-definition. ### 550. explain (v.) - Definition: to make clear - תרגום: להסביר - Example 1: Explain the process to me. - Example 2: She explained her decision. - Synonyms: describe, clarify - 💡 Memory tip: explain X to Y. ### 551. clarify (v.) - Definition: to make easier to understand - תרגום: להבהיר - Example 1: Can you clarify what you mean? - Example 2: She clarified the instructions. - Synonyms: explain, simplify - 💡 Memory tip: מ-clear = להפוך לברור. ### 552. simplify (v.) - Definition: to make simpler - תרגום: לפשט - Example 1: Can we simplify this process? - Example 2: The new design simplifies the interface. - Synonyms: clarify, streamline - Antonyms: complicate - 💡 Memory tip: simple + -ify (לעשות פשוט). ### 553. summarize (v.) - Definition: to give the main points briefly - תרגום: לסכם - Example 1: Please summarize the article. - Example 2: She summarized the main ideas. - Synonyms: sum up, recap - 💡 Memory tip: מ-summary (סיכום). ### 554. conclude (v.) - Definition: to end; to decide after thinking - תרגום: לסיים; להסיק - Example 1: The meeting concluded at 5 PM. - Example 2: We concluded that he was right. - Synonyms: finish, deduce - Antonyms: begin - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: סיום / הסקת מסקנה. ### 555. assess (v.) - Definition: to evaluate - תרגום: להעריך - Example 1: The teacher assessed our work. - Example 2: Let's assess the situation. - Synonyms: evaluate, judge - 💡 Memory tip: קשור ל-assessment (הערכה). ### 556. evaluate (v.) - Definition: to judge the value of - תרגום: להעריך - Example 1: We need to evaluate the results. - Example 2: She evaluates job applicants. - Synonyms: assess, judge - 💡 Memory tip: value באמצע - מעריכים את הערך. ### 557. estimate (v.) - Definition: to roughly calculate - תרגום: להעריך, לאמוד - Example 1: I estimate it'll cost $100. - Example 2: Can you estimate the distance? - Synonyms: guess, calculate - 💡 Memory tip: הערכה משוערת, לא מדויקת. ### 558. calculate (v.) - Definition: to compute with numbers - תרגום: לחשב - Example 1: She calculated the total cost. - Example 2: Calculate the average of these numbers. - Synonyms: compute, figure out - 💡 Memory tip: עם מספרים - תהליך מדויק. ### 559. predict (v.) - Definition: to say what will happen - תרגום: לחזות - Example 1: Who can predict the future? - Example 2: Experts predict economic growth. - Synonyms: forecast, foretell - 💡 Memory tip: pre- (לפני) + dict (לומר) = לומר לפני. ### 560. forecast (v.) - Definition: to predict (often weather/economics) - תרגום: לחזות (תחזית) - Example 1: They forecast rain for tomorrow. - Example 2: Economists forecast growth. - Synonyms: predict - 💡 Memory tip: weather forecast = תחזית מזג אוויר. --- # 💬 קטגוריה 3: פעלי תקשורת פורמלית (30 מילים) ### 561. express (v.) - Definition: to communicate thoughts or feelings - תרגום: לבטא - Example 1: She expressed her gratitude. - Example 2: I can't express how I feel. - Synonyms: communicate, convey - 💡 Memory tip: express feelings/opinions/gratitude. ### 562. communicate (v.) - Definition: to share information - תרגום: לתקשר - Example 1: We communicate mostly by email. - Example 2: He communicates well in English. - Synonyms: share, convey, speak - 💡 Memory tip: communication - הבסיס לתקשורת. ### 563. convey (v.) - Definition: to communicate; to carry - תרגום: להעביר, להביע - Example 1: Words can't convey my feelings. - Example 2: The message was conveyed quickly. - Synonyms: express, communicate, transport - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-communicate. ### 564. describe (v.) - Definition: to give details about - תרגום: לתאר - Example 1: Can you describe what you saw? - Example 2: The book describes life in Russia. - Synonyms: depict, explain, portray - 💡 Memory tip: describe X as Y. ### 565. mention (v.) - Definition: to refer to briefly - תרגום: להזכיר, לציין - Example 1: He mentioned that he was tired. - Example 2: Don't mention it to anyone. - Synonyms: refer to, note - 💡 Memory tip: "don't mention it" = "אין בעד מה". ### 566. refer (v.) - Definition: to mention; to direct to - תרגום: להתייחס, להפנות - Example 1: She referred to the report. - Example 2: The doctor referred me to a specialist. - Synonyms: mention, direct, allude - 💡 Memory tip: refer to X. ### 567. indicate (v.) - Definition: to show or point out - תרגום: לציין, לרמוז - Example 1: The sign indicates the way. - Example 2: Her smile indicated she was pleased. - Synonyms: show, suggest, signal - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי. research indicates = מחקר מציין. ### 568. imply (v.) - Definition: to suggest without saying directly - תרגום: לרמוז - Example 1: Are you implying I'm wrong? - Example 2: Her tone implied anger. - Synonyms: suggest, hint - 💡 Memory tip: imply = רמז שנשלח; infer = רמז שנקלט. ### 569. state (v.) - Definition: to say clearly and formally - תרגום: להצהיר - Example 1: She stated her opinion clearly. - Example 2: The law states that... - Synonyms: declare, announce, say - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: state of mind. ### 570. declare (v.) - Definition: to state officially - תרגום: להצהיר, להכריז - Example 1: The country declared war. - Example 2: I declare this meeting open. - Synonyms: announce, state - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד, בהקשרים רשמיים. ### 571. announce (v.) - Definition: to make known publicly - תרגום: להכריז - Example 1: They announced the winner. - Example 2: She announced her engagement. - Synonyms: declare, reveal - 💡 Memory tip: announcement = הכרזה. ### 572. reveal (v.) - Definition: to make known something hidden - תרגום: לחשוף - Example 1: She revealed her secret. - Example 2: The study revealed new findings. - Synonyms: disclose, expose - Antonyms: hide, conceal - 💡 Memory tip: re-veil = להסיר את הצעיף. ### 573. admit (v.) - Definition: to accept as true; to allow in - תרגום: להודות, להכניס - Example 1: He admitted his mistake. - Example 2: She was admitted to the hospital. - Synonyms: confess, acknowledge, let in - Antonyms: deny, refuse - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: להודות / להכניס. ### 574. deny (v.) - Definition: to state that something is not true - תרגום: להכחיש - Example 1: He denied stealing the money. - Example 2: She denied the accusations. - Synonyms: reject, refuse - Antonyms: admit, confirm - 💡 Memory tip: ההפך של admit או confirm. ### 575. confirm (v.) - Definition: to prove or declare true - תרגום: לאשר - Example 1: Can you confirm the meeting? - Example 2: The results confirmed our theory. - Synonyms: verify, validate - Antonyms: deny, disprove - 💡 Memory tip: confirmation = אישור. ### 576. verify (v.) - Definition: to check that something is true - תרגום: לאמת - Example 1: Please verify your email. - Example 2: We need to verify the facts. - Synonyms: confirm, check - 💡 Memory tip: דומה ל-confirm אבל עם בדיקה. ### 577. argue (v.) - Definition: to give reasons; to disagree verbally - תרגום: לטעון, להתווכח - Example 1: Scientists argue that climate is changing. - Example 2: They argue every day. - Synonyms: claim, debate, quarrel - 💡 Memory tip: גם בהקשר אקדמי (לטעון טיעון). ### 578. debate (v.) - Definition: to discuss formally - תרגום: להתווכח, לדון - Example 1: We debated the issue for hours. - Example 2: The candidates debated on TV. - Synonyms: discuss, argue - 💡 Memory tip: דיון מאורגן על נושא. ### 579. discuss (v.) - תרגום: להעביר, להוביל - Example 1: Trains transport passengers daily. - Example 2: The ship transports goods overseas. - Synonyms: carry, move, deliver - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: public transport. ### 510. produce (v.) - Definition: to make or create - תרגום: לייצר, לייצר - Example 1: This factory produces cars. - Example 2: The plant produces fruit every year. - Synonyms: make, create, manufacture - Antonyms: destroy - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: פועל /prəˈduːs/, שם עצם /ˈprɒdjuːs/. ### 511. create (v.) - Definition: to make something new - תרגום: ליצור - Example 1: She created a beautiful painting. - Example 2: We need to create a solution. - Synonyms: make, produce, build - Antonyms: destroy - 💡 Memory tip: create = יצירה מחדש; produce = ייצור כמותי. ### 512. design (v.) - Definition: to plan the look of something - תרגום: לעצב, לתכנן - Example 1: She designed the new logo. - Example 2: The architect designed the building. - Synonyms: plan, create - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "a beautiful design". ### 513. develop (v.) - Definition: to grow or improve - תרגום: לפתח - Example 1: Children develop quickly. - Example 2: The company developed a new product. - Synonyms: grow, create, advance - 💡 Memory tip: develop skills/products/relationships. ### 514. improve (v.) - Definition: to make or become better - תרגום: לשפר - Example 1: Practice helps you improve. - Example 2: We need to improve our performance. - Synonyms: enhance, better, upgrade - Antonyms: worsen - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: improve skills/quality/performance. ### 515. enhance (v.) - Definition: to improve the quality of - תרגום: לשפר, להעצים - Example 1: The software enhances the image. - Example 2: Music can enhance your mood. - Synonyms: improve, boost - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-improve. ### 516. encourage (v.) - Definition: to give support and confidence - תרגום: לעודד - Example 1: My parents encouraged me to study. - Example 2: The teacher encourages creativity. - Synonyms: support, motivate - Antonyms: discourage - 💡 Memory tip: encourage someone to V. ### 517. discourage (v.) - Definition: to make someone less confident - תרגום: להרתיע - Example 1: Don't let failure discourage you. - Example 2: The bad weather discouraged them. - Synonyms: deter, dishearten - Antonyms: encourage - 💡 Memory tip: dis- = הפוך של encourage. ### 518. recommend (v.) - Definition: to suggest something as good - תרגום: להמליץ - Example 1: I recommend this book. - Example 2: The doctor recommended rest. - Synonyms: suggest, advise - 💡 Memory tip: recommend + V-ing או recommend that + subjunctive. ### 519. suggest (v.) - Definition: to propose an idea - תרגום: להציע, לרמוז - Example 1: I suggest we leave early. - Example 2: The evidence suggests he's innocent. - Synonyms: propose, recommend, imply - 💡 Memory tip: גם "לרמוז": evidence suggests. ### 520. propose (v.) - Definition: to put forward an idea - תרגום: להציע - Example 1: She proposed a new plan. - Example 2: He proposed marriage to her. - Synonyms: suggest, offer - 💡 Memory tip: יותר פורמלי מ-suggest. גם: להציע נישואין. ### 521. offer (v.) - Definition: to present for acceptance - תרגום: להציע - Example 1: They offered me a job. - Example 2: Can I offer you some coffee? - Synonyms: provide, present - Antonyms: refuse - 💡 Memory tip: offer X to Y / offer to V. ### 522. refuse (v.) - Definition: to say no to something - תרגום: לסרב - Example 1: He refused to help me. - Example 2: She refused the invitation. - Synonyms: decline, reject - Antonyms: accept, agree - 💡 Memory tip: refuse to V = לסרב לעשות. ### 523. reject (v.) - Definition: to not accept - תרגום: לדחות - Example 1: The committee rejected the proposal. - Example 2: She rejected the offer. - Synonyms: refuse, decline, turn down - Antonyms: accept, approve - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-refuse; בהקשר החלטות. ### 524. approve (v.) - Definition: to accept as good; to give permission - תרגום: לאשר - Example 1: The boss approved the project. - Example 2: I don't approve of smoking. - Synonyms: accept, sanction - Antonyms: reject, disapprove - 💡 Memory tip: approve of X = לאשר/לחזק X. ### 525. request (v.) - Definition: to ask politely for - תרגום: לבקש - Example 1: She requested a glass of water. - Example 2: I request your attention. - Synonyms: ask, seek - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-ask. ### 526. demand (v.) - Definition: to ask forcefully - תרגום: לדרוש - Example 1: Workers demanded higher pay. - Example 2: The situation demands attention. - Synonyms: require, insist on - 💡 Memory tip: חזק יותר מ-request או ask. ### 527. require (v.) - Definition: to need - תרגום: לדרוש, להזדקק - Example 1: This job requires experience. - Example 2: Plants require water to grow. - Synonyms: need, demand - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-need. ### 528. prevent (v.) - Definition: to stop something from happening - תרגום: למנוע - Example 1: Exercise prevents disease. - Example 2: Rain prevented the game. - Synonyms: stop, block, avoid - Antonyms: allow, enable - 💡 Memory tip: prevent someone from V-ing. ### 529. cause (v.) - Definition: to make something happen - תרגום: לגרום - Example 1: Smoking causes cancer. - Example 2: The storm caused damage. - Synonyms: produce, result in - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "cause and effect". ### 530. affect (v.) - Definition: to have an effect on - תרגום: להשפיע על - Example 1: The news affected everyone. - Example 2: Stress affects your health. - Example 2: She analyzed the problem logically. - Synonyms: examine, study, investigate - 💡 Memory tip: גם analyse (בריטי). ### 532. examine (v.) - Definition: to inspect carefully - תרגום: לבדוק, לחקור - Example 1: The doctor examined the patient. - Example 2: Let's examine the evidence. - Synonyms: inspect, analyze, check - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-check. ### 533. investigate (v.) - Definition: to research carefully - תרגום: לחקור - Example 1: The police are investigating the crime. - Example 2: We need to investigate the cause. - Synonyms: research, examine, probe - 💡 Memory tip: קשור למשטרה ולחקירות מדעיות. ### 534. research (v.) - Definition: to study carefully - תרגום: לחקור - Example 1: I researched the topic for days. - Example 2: Scientists research new medicines. - Synonyms: study, investigate - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "scientific research". ### 535. observe (v.) - Definition: to watch carefully - תרגום: להתבונן, לצפות - Example 1: The children observed the butterflies. - Example 2: I observed a change in behavior. - Synonyms: watch, notice, witness - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-watch. ### 536. notice (v.) - Definition: to become aware of - תרגום: לשים לב - Example 1: Did you notice her new haircut? - Example 2: I noticed something strange. - Synonyms: observe, see, spot - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "a notice on the board". ### 537. realize (v.) - Definition: to become aware of; to make real - תרגום: להבין, לקלוט; להגשים - Example 1: I realized my mistake too late. - Example 2: She realized her dream. - Synonyms: understand, recognize; achieve - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים. הבריטי: realise. ### 538. recognize (v.) - Definition: to identify something known - תרגום: לזהות, להכיר - Example 1: I didn't recognize her with short hair. - Example 2: The school recognizes hard work. - Synonyms: recognize, determine - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-recognize. ### 540. determine (v.) - Definition: to decide or find out - תרגום: לקבוע, להחליט - Example 1: We need to determine the cause. - Example 2: She determined to succeed. - Synonyms: decide, establish - 💡 Memory tip: קשור ל-determination (נחישות). ### 541. consider (v.) - Definition: to think about carefully - תרגום: לשקול, לחשוב על - Example 1: Consider all your options. - Example 2: I consider him a friend. - Synonyms: think about, regard - 💡 Memory tip: consider + V-ing = שוקל לעשות. ### 542. assume (v.) - Definition: to believe without proof - תרגום: להניח - Example 1: I assume you're coming. - Example 2: Don't assume - ask! - Synonyms: presume, suppose - Antonyms: know, verify - 💡 Memory tip: הנחה ללא הוכחה. ### 543. suppose (v.) - Definition: to think likely; to assume - Definition: the ability to lead - תרגום: מנהיגות - Example 1: Her leadership saved the company. - Example 2: Leadership requires courage. - Synonyms: guidance, direction - 💡 Memory tip: leader + -ship = התכונה. ### 666. power (n.) - Definition: authority; strength; electricity - תרגום: כוח, שלטון - Example 1: He abuses his power. - Example 2: The power went out. - Synonyms: authority, strength - 💡 Memory tip: הרבה מובנים! תלוי בהקשר. ### 667. authority (n.) - Definition: the power to make decisions - תרגום: סמכות, רשות - Example 1: She has the authority to approve this. - Example 2: The authorities are investigating. - Synonyms: power, command - 💡 Memory tip: "Authorities" = רשויות (המשטרה, השלטון). ### 668. influence (n.) - Definition: the power to affect - תרגום: השפעה - Example 1: Social media has a big influence. - Example 2: His influence is growing. - Synonyms: effect, impact - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל. ### 669. impact (n.) - Definition: a powerful effect - תרגום: השפעה, השלכה - Example 1: Climate change has a huge impact. - Example 2: Her speech had a great impact. - Synonyms: effect, influence - 💡

Example 2: Every country needs a government. - Synonyms: administration, authorities - 💡 Memory tip: מ-govern (למשול). ### 654. politics (n.) - Definition: activities of government - תרגום: פוליטיקה - Example 1: I don't follow politics. - Example 2: Politics is complicated. - Synonyms: government affairs - 💡 Memory tip: politics יחיד אף שנגמר ב-s. ### 655. law (n.) - Definition: a system of rules - תרגום: חוק - Example 1: Breaking the law has consequences. - Example 2: She studies law. - Synonyms: rule, legislation - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: laws. ### 656. rule (n.) - Definition: an instruction about what to do - תרגום: כלל, חוק - Example 1: Follow the rules of the game. - Example 2: There's a rule against smoking here. - Synonyms: regulation, law - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: to rule = למשול. ### 657. justice (n.) - Definition: fairness; the legal system - תרגום: צדק - Example 1: We demand justice for the victim. - Example 2: The justice system must work fairly. - Synonyms: fairness, righteousness - Antonyms: injustice - 💡 Memory tip: just (adj) = צודק. ### 658. right (n.) - Definition: a moral or legal entitlement - תרגום: זכות - Example 1: Everyone has the right to free speech. - Example 2: Women's rights are human rights. - Synonyms: entitlement, privilege - 💡 Memory tip: הרבה מובנים - גם "ימין", גם "נכון". ### 659. freedom (n.) - Definition: the state of being free - תרגום: חופש, חירות - Example 1: Freedom is a basic right. - Example 2: I cherish my freedom. - Synonyms: liberty, independence - Antonyms: slavery, oppression - 💡 Memory tip: מ-free + -dom. ### 660. election (n.) - Definition: a formal vote - תרגום: בחירות - Example 1: The election is next month. - Example 1: The company's policy is fair. - Example 2: Immigration policy is changing. - Synonyms: plan, strategy - 💡 Memory tip: policies (plural). ### 664. leader (n.) - Definition: a person who guides others - תרגום: מנהיג - Example 1: A good leader inspires others. - Example 2: She became the leader of the group. - Synonyms: chief, head - Antonyms: follower - 💡 Memory tip: lead + -er. ### 665. leadership (n.) - Definition: the ability to lead - תרגום: מנהיגות - Example 1: Her leadership saved the company. - Example 2: Leadership requires courage. - Synonyms: guidance, direction - 💡 Memory tip: leader + -ship = התכונה. ### 666. power (n.) - Definition: authority; strength; electricity - תרגום: כוח, שלטון - Example 1: He abuses his power. - Example 2: The power went out. - Synonyms: authority, strength - 💡 Memory tip: הרבה מובנים! תלוי בהקשר. ### 667. authority (n.) - Definition: the power to make decisions - תרגום: סמכות, רשות - Example 1: She has the authority to approve this. - Example 2: The authorities are investigating. - Synonyms: power, command - 💡 Memory tip: "Authorities" = רשויות (המשטרה, השלטון). ### 668. influence (n.) - Definition: the power to affect - תרגום: השפעה - Example 1: Social media has a big influence. - Example 2: His influence is growing. - Synonyms: effect, impact - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל. ### 669. impact (n.) - Definition: a powerful effect - תרגום: השפעה, השלכה - Example 1: Climate change has a huge impact. - Example 2: Her speech had a great impact. - Synonyms: effect, influence - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי ואקדמי. ### 670. effect (n.) - Definition: a result - תרגום: השפעה, תוצאה - Example 1: The medicine had no effect. - Example 2: Side effects include headaches. - Synonyms: result, consequence - 💡 Memory tip: effect (n) ≠ affect (v)! ### 671. cause (n.) - Definition: a result of an action - תרגום: השלכה, תוצאה - Example 1: Actions have consequences. - Example 2: The consequences are serious. - Synonyms: result, effect - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי ורשמי. ### 673. reason (n.) - Definition: a cause; the ability to think - תרגום: סיבה; שיקול דעת - Example 1: There's no reason to worry. - Example 2: Use your reason. - Synonyms: cause, logic - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים. ### 674. purpose (n.) - תרגום: ניכר, משמעותי - Example 1: A substantial amount of money. - Example 2: Substantial progress was made. - Synonyms: considerable, significant - Antonyms: minor - 💡 Memory tip: substance (שם עצם) = חומר/מהות. ### 868. minor (adj.) - תרגום: לאמת, לאשש - Example 1: The witness corroborated his story. - Example 2: The evidence corroborates our theory. - Synonyms: confirm, verify, support - 💡 Memory tip: אישור חיצוני לטיעון. ### 1013. validate (v.) - Definition: to prove wrong - תרגום: להפריך - Example 1: Scientists refuted the old theory. - Example 2: She refuted his argument. - Synonyms: disprove, rebut - Antonyms: confirm, support - 💡 Memory tip: הפרכה פורמלית. ### 1015. dispute (v.) - Definition: to argue against - תרגום: לחלוק, לערער - Example 1: I don't dispute the facts. - Example 2: The companies disputed the contract. - Synonyms: contest, challenge - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: מחלוקת. ### 1016. challenge (v.) - Definition: to question; to invite to compete - תרגום: לערער, לאתגר - Example 1: She challenged his authority. - Example 2: I challenge you to a game. - Synonyms: question, contest, dispute - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם. ### 1017. acknowledge (v.) - Definition: to accept or admit - תרגום: להכיר, להודות - Example 1: He acknowledged his mistake. - Example 2: The government acknowledged the problem. - Synonyms: admit, recognize - Antonyms: deny - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-admit. ### 1018. recognize (v.) - Definition: to accept as valid - תרגום: להכיר, לזהות - Example 1: We recognize her contribution. - Example 2: The court recognized the agreement. - Synonyms: acknowledge, accept - 💡 Memory tip: גם: לזהות ויזוא

- Synonyms: declare; articulate - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים חשובים. ### 1503. profess (v.) - Definition: to claim openly - תרגום: להכריז על - Example 1: He professes his innocence. - Example 2: She professes her love for art. - Synonyms: declare, claim - 💡 Memory tip: מ-professor (מי שמצהיר על ידע). ### 1504. attest (v.) - Definition: to provide evidence of - תרגום: להעיד על - Example 1: The document attests to his identity. - Example 2: Many can attest to his kindness. - Synonyms: testify, confirm - 💡 Memory tip: attest to X = לתת עדות ל-X. ### 1505. testify (v.) - Definition: to give evidence in court - תרגום: להעיד - Example 1: She testified in court. - Example 2: I can testify to her skill. - Synonyms: attest, witness - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי - עדות בבית משפט. ### 1506. affirm (v.) - Definition: to state as fact - תרגום: לאשר, להצהיר - Example 1: She affirmed her commitment. - Example 2: The court affirmed the ruling. - Synonyms: confirm, assert - Antonyms: deny - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי - אישור או קביעה. ### 1507. reaffirm (v.) - Definition: to state again strongly - תרגום: לשוב ולאשר - Example 1: The meeting reaffirmed our goals. - Example 2: She reaffirmed her loyalty. - Synonyms: reassert, restate - 💡 Memory tip: re- + affirm = לאשר מחדש. ### 1508. refrain (v.) - Definition: to stop oneself from doing - תרגום: להימנע - Example 1: Please refrain from smoking. - Example 2: He refrained from commenting. - Synonyms: abstain, avoid - 💡 Memory tip: refrain from V-ing. ### 1509. abstain (v.) - Definition: to choose not to do something - תרגום: להימנע (במכוון) - Example 1: I abstain from alcohol. - Example 2: She abstained from voting. - Synonyms: refrain, avoid - 💡 Memory tip: abstain from X. בעיקר דברים פיתוי. ### 1510. concede - already covered at #1114. Skipping. ### 1510. relinquish (v.) - Definition: to voluntarily give up - תרגום: לוותר על - Example 1: He relinquished his title. - Example 2: Relinquish your claim to the throne. - Synonyms: surrender, give up - 💡 Memory tip: ויתור פורמלי. ### 1511. renounce (v.) - Definition: to formally give up - תרגום: להתנער מ-, לוותר על - Example 1: He renounced his citizenship. - Example 2: She renounced violence. - Synonyms: abandon, disavow - 💡 Memory tip: ויתור על רעיון או זהות. ### 1512. disavow (v.) - Definition: to deny connection with - תרגום: להתנער מ- - Example 1: The party disavowed his statement. - Example 2: He disavowed responsibility. - Synonyms: deny, renounce - 💡 Memory tip: dis- + avow (להודות). ### 1513. avow (v.) - Definition: to openly declare - תרגום: להכריז בגלוי - Example 1: He avowed his love. - Example 2: She avowed her intentions. - Synonyms: declare, acknowledge - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - הצהרה גלויה. ### 1514. concur (v.) - Definition: to agree - תרגום: להסכים - Example 1: I concur with your assessment. - Example 2: The experts concurred. - Synonyms: agree, consent - Antonyms: disagree - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-agree. ### 1515. consent (v.) - Definition: to give permission - תרגום: להסכים - Example 1: She consented to the procedure. - Example 2: They consented to our request. - Synonyms: agree, approve - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: הסכמה. ### 1516. assent (v.) - Definition: to express agreement - תרגום: להסכים - Example 1: He assented with a nod. - Example 2: They assented to the plan. - Synonyms: agree, consent - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד - ספרותי. ### 1517. dissent (v.) - Definition: to disagree - תרגום: לחלוק, להתנגד - Example 1: Two judges dissented. - Example 2: She dissented from the majority. - Synonyms: disagree, object - Antonyms: assent, agree - 💡 Memory tip: dis- + assent. ### 1518. presume (v.) - Definition: to suppose - תרגום: להניח - Example 1: I presume you're tired. - Example 2: Presumed innocent until proven guilty. - Synonyms: assume, suppose - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-assume. ### 1519. surmise (v.) - Definition: to guess based on limited evidence - תרגום: לשער - Example 1: I surmise he's gone home. - Example 2: We can only surmise what happened. - Synonyms: guess, suppose - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - השערה חלקית.

Example 2: We can only conjecture. - Synonyms: speculate, guess - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: השערה. ### 1521. posit (v.) - Definition: to assume as fact; to suggest - תרגום: להניח, להציע - Example 1: The theory posits that time is relative. - Example 2: She posited an interesting idea. - Synonyms: propose, suggest - 💡 Memory tip: פילוסופי ואקדמי מאוד. ### 1522. stipulate (v.) - Definition: to specify as a condition - תרגום: להתנות - Example 1: The contract stipulates payment terms. - Example 2: She stipulated no photos. - Synonyms: specify, require - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי - משפטי. ### 1523. elucidate (v.) - Definition: to make clear - תרגום: להבהיר, לבאר - Example 1: Please elucidate your point. - Example 2: The article elucidates the theory. - Synonyms: clarify, explain - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - הבהרה אלגנטית. ### 1524. expound (v.) - Definition: to explain in detail - תרגום: להרחיב ולהסביר - Example 1: He expounded on his theory. - Example 2: She expounded the principles. - Synonyms: explain, elaborate - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי - הסבר מפורט. ### 1525. expatiate (v.) - Definition: to speak or write at length - תרגום: להאריך בדיבור/כתיבה - Example 1: She expatiated on her travels. - Example 2: Don't expatiate too much. - Synonyms: elaborate, expound - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ונדיר. ### 1526. pontificate (v.) - Definition: to speak pompously - תרגום: לטעון בטון של מומחה - Example 1: He pontificates on politics. - Example 2: Stop pontificating! - Synonyms: lecture, preach - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי - מדבר כאילו הוא מומחה מוחלט. ### 1527. dictate (v.) - Definition: to give orders; to say for recording - תרגום: להכתיב - Example 1: Don't dictate to me! - Example 2: She dictated the letter. - Synonyms: command; speak - 💡 Memory tip: dictator = דיקטטור. ### 1528. mandate (v.) - Definition: to require officially - תרגום: לחייב באופן רשמי - Example 1: The law mandates safety checks. - Example 2: Vaccines are mandated. - Synonyms: require, order - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: מנדט. ### 1529. enact (v.) - Definition: to make into law - תרגום: לחוקק - Example 1: They enacted a new law. - Example 2: The reforms were enacted. - Synonyms: legislate, pass - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי - חקיקה. ### 1530. impose (v.) - Definition: to force; to establish by authority - תרגום: לכפות, להטיל - Example 1: They imposed new taxes. - Example 2: Don't impose your views. - Synonyms: force, enforce - 💡 Memory tip: impose on X = לכפות על X. --- # 🔍 קטגוריה 2: פעלי הערכה וביקורת עדינה (30 מילים) ### 1531. scrutinize (v.) - Definition: to examine very closely - תרגום: לבחון בקפדנות - Example 1: The auditor scrutinized the records. - Example 2: Scrutinize every detail. - Synonyms: examine, inspect - 💡 Memory tip: בדיקה קפדנית וחודרת. ### 1532. peruse (v.) - Definition: to read carefully - תרגום: לעיין בקפידה - Example 1: She perused the document. - Example 2: I'll peruse the menu. - Synonyms: read, examine - 💡 Memory tip: קריאה מעמיקה ומדוקדקת. ### 1533. inspect (v.) - Definition: to examine closely - תרגום: לבחון, לפקח - Example 1: The officer inspected the car. - Example 2: Please inspect the merchandise. - Synonyms: examine, check - 💡 Memory tip: inspection (n). ### 1534. appraise (v.) - Definition: to assess the value - תרגום: להעריך - Example 1: Experts appraised the painting. - Example 2: She appraised the situation. - Synonyms: evaluate, assess - 💡 Memory tip: בעיקר הערכת שווי. ### 1535. gauge (v.) - Definition: to measure or judge - תרגום: לשער, להעריך - Example 1: It's hard to gauge her reaction. - Example 2: Gauge the depth carefully. - Synonyms: measure, estimate - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: /ɡeɪdʒ/. ### 1536. quantify (v.) - Definition: to express as a number - תרגום: לכמת - Example 1: It's hard to quantify love. - Example 2: Can we quantify the damage? - Synonyms: measure, calculate - 💡 Memory tip: מ-quantity. ### 1537. qualify (v.) - Definition: to be eligible; to limit - תרגום: להיות זכאי; לסייג - Example 1: She qualifies for the job. - Example 2: Let me qualify that statement. - Synonyms: entitle; limit, restrict - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: להיות זכאי / לסייג. ### 1538. authenticate (v.) - Definition: to prove genuine - תרגום: לאמת - Example 1: Experts authenticated the painting. - Example 2: Authenticate your identity. - Synonyms: verify, validate - 💡 Memory tip: מ-authentic (אותנטי). ### 1539. verify - already covered at #576. Skipping. ### 1539. corroborate - already covered at #1012. Skipping. ### 1539. rectify (v.) - Definition: to correct - תרגום: לתקן - Example 1: Please rectify the error. - Example 2: We need to rectify this injustice. - Synonyms: correct, fix - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי - תיקון טעות. ### 1540. amend - already covered at #1061. Skipping. ### 1540. revise - already covered at #1062. Skipping. ### 1540. reconcile (v.) - Definition: to restore friendly relations; to make compatible - תרגום: לפייס; להתאים - Example 1: They reconciled after a fight. - Example 2: Reconcile the two figures. - Synonyms: make peace; harmonize - 💡 Memory tip: reconciliation (n) = פיוס. ### 1541. harmonize (v.) - Definition: to bring into harmony - תרגום: להרמוני, להתאים - Example 1: The colors harmonize well. - Example 2: Harmonize different policies. - Synonyms: coordinate, match - 💡 Memory tip: מ-harmony. ### 1542. synchronize (v.) - Definition: to make happen at the same time - תרגום: לסנכרן - Example 1: Synchronize your watches. - Example 2: Synchronize the dance steps. - Synonyms: coordinate, align - 💡 Memory tip: syn- + chrono (זמן). ### 1543. align (v.) - Definition: to arrange in a line; to bring into agreement - תרגום: ליישר; להתיישר - Example 1: Align the pages. - Example 2: Our goals align well. - Synonyms: arrange, coordinate - 💡 Memory tip: גם פיזי וגם מטפורי. ### 1544. delineate (v.) - Definition: to describe or draw precisely - תרגום: לתחם, לתאר במדויק - Example 1: She delineated her plan. - Example 2: The boundaries are delineated. - Synonyms: outline, describe - 💡 Memory tip: מ-line - קווים של תיאור. ### 1545. demarcate (v.) - Definition: to set boundaries - תרגום: לתחם - Example 1: Demarcate the zones. - Example 2: The border is clearly demarcated. - Synonyms: delineate, separate - 💡 Memory tip: מ-mark (סימון). ### 1546. differentiate (v.) - Definition: to recognize differences - תרגום: להבחין, להבדיל - Example 1: Differentiate between fact and opinion. - Example 2: The features differentiate them. - Synonyms: distinguish, tell apart - 💡 Memory tip: מ-different. ### 1547. categorize (v.) - Definition: to place in categories - תרגום: לסווג - Example 1: Categorize these files. - Example 2: She categorizes her books by genre. - Synonyms: classify, sort - 💡 Memory tip: מ-category. ### 1548. classify (v.) - Definition: to arrange in categories - תרגום: לסווג - Example 1: Classify the species. - Example 2: Documents are classified. - Synonyms: categorize, sort - 💡 Memory tip: גם: to mark as secret. ### 1549. juxtapose (v.) - Definition: to place side by side - תרגום: להציב זה לצד זה - Example 1: Juxtapose the two photos. - Example 2: The author juxtaposes wealth and poverty. - Synonyms: compare, contrast - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ואקדמי - להדגשה. ### 1550. correlate (v.) - Definition: to have a mutual relationship - תרגום: להיות במתאם - Example 1: Smoking correlates with cancer. - Example 2: The data correlates. - Synonyms: connect, relate - 💡 Memory tip: correlation (n). ### 1551. denote (v.) - Definition: to indicate or mean - תרגום: לציין, לסמן - Example 1: This symbol denotes danger. - Example 2: Her silence denoted agreement. - Synonyms: indicate, signify - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי - סימון ברור. ### 1552. connote (v.) - Definition: to suggest (indirect meaning) - תרגום: לרמוז (משמעות נוספת) - Example 1: The word connotes luxury. - Example 2: "Home" connotes warmth. - contentBlocks.body: # 🏆 Mastery Level – 100 מילים ברמה ספרותית-אקדמית עליונה ## החבילה הסופית - מילים לשליטה מלאה מטרה: מילים נדירות, ספרותיות ואקדמיות ברמה הגבוהה ביותר באנגלית קהל יעד: תלמידים מצטיינים שמכוונים לציון 134+ (פטור מלא) מקורות: GRE, SAT, ספרות קלאסית, עיתונות איכותית (NYT, The Economist, New Yorker) אזהרה: אלו מילים מאתגרות. רבות מהן נדירות גם בקרב דוברי אנגלית ילידיים! --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלים ספרותיים-אקדמיים (2151-2180) - 30 מילים 2. שמות עצם נדירים ומתוחכמים (2181-2210) - 30 מילים 3. תארים מושכלים-ספרותיים (2211-2240) - 30 מילים 4. ביטויים אקדמיים גבוהים (2241-2250) - 10 מילים --- # 🎭 קטגוריה 1: פעלים ספרותיים-אקדמיים (30 מילים) ### 2151. extol (v.) - Definition: to praise enthusiastically - תרגום: להלל, לשבח עד מאוד - Example 1: Critics extolled her novel. - Example 2: He extols the virtues of patience. - Synonyms: praise, glorify, laud - 💡 Memory tip: הלל נלהב ופורמלי. מופיע ב-NYT. ### 2152. admonish (v.) - Definition: to warn or reprimand firmly - תרגום: להזהיר, לנזוף ברצינות - Example 1: The teacher admonished the students. - Example 2: She was admonished for her behavior. - Synonyms: reprimand, warn - 💡 Memory tip: אזהרה חמורה אך בונה. ### 2153. beleaguer (v.) - Definition: to surround with difficulties - תרגום: להציק, להציק ברציפות - Example 1: Beleaguered by problems. - Example 2: The city was beleaguered. - Synonyms: besiege, beset - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - קושי מתמשך. ### 2154. castigate (v.) - Definition: to criticize severely - תרגום: למתוח ביקורת קשה - Example 1: Critics castigated the film. - Example 2: He was castigated for his errors. - Synonyms: criticize, chastise - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת חריפה. ### 2155. chastise (v.) - Definition: to criticize strongly - תרגום: לייסר, לנזוף - Example 1: Chastised for carelessness. - Example 2: She chastised him

contentBlocks.body: # 🏆 Mastery Level – 100 מילים ברמה ספרותית-אקדמית עליונה ## החבילה הסופית - מילים לשליטה מלאה מטרה: מילים נדירות, ספרותיות ואקדמיות ברמה הגבוהה ביותר באנגלית קהל יעד: תלמידים מצטיינים שמכוונים לציון 134+ (פטור מלא) מקורות: GRE, SAT, ספרות קלאסית, עיתונות איכותית (NYT, The Economist, New Yorker) אזהרה: אלו מילים מאתגרות. רבות מהן נדירות גם בקרב דוברי אנגלית ילידיים! --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלים ספרותיים-אקדמיים (2151-2180) - 30 מילים 2. שמות עצם נדירים ומתוחכמים (2181-2210) - 30 מילים 3. תארים מושכלים-ספרותיים (2211-2240) - 30 מילים 4. ביטויים אקדמיים גבוהים (2241-2250) - 10 מילים --- # 🎭 קטגוריה 1: פעלים ספרותיים-אקדמיים (30 מילים) ### 2151. extol (v.) - Definition: to praise enthusiastically - תרגום: להלל, לשבח עד מאוד - Example 1: Critics extolled her novel. - Example 2: He extols the virtues of patience. - Synonyms: praise, glorify, laud - 💡 Memory tip: הלל נלהב ופורמלי. מופיע ב-NYT. ### 2152. admonish (v.) - Definition: to warn or reprimand firmly - תרגום: להזהיר, לנזוף ברצינות - Example 1: The teacher admonished the students. - Example 2: She was admonished for her behavior. - Synonyms: reprimand, warn - 💡 Memory tip: אזהרה חמורה אך בונה. ### 2153. beleaguer (v.) - Definition: to surround with difficulties - תרגום: להציק, להציק ברציפות - Example 1: Beleaguered by problems. - Example 2: The city was beleaguered. - Synonyms: besiege, beset - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - קושי מתמשך. ### 2154. castigate (v.) - Definition: to criticize severely - תרגום: למתוח ביקורת קשה - Example 1: Critics castigated the film. - Example 2: He was castigated for his errors. - Synonyms: criticize, chastise - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת חריפה. ### 2155. chastise (v.) - Definition: to criticize strongly - תרגום: לייסר, לנזוף - Example 1: Chastised for carelessness. - Example 2: She chastised him publicly. - Synonyms: castigate, scold - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי. ### 2156. exacerbate (v.) - Definition: to make worse - תרגום: להחמיר - Example 1: Stress exacerbates the problem. - Example 2: His words exacerbated tensions. - Synonyms: worsen, aggravate - Antonyms: alleviate, mitigate - 💡 Memory tip: מופיע בכתבות על פוליטיקה וכלכלה. ### 2157. mitigate (v.) - Definition: to make less severe - תרגום: להקל, למתן - Example 1: Measures to mitigate damage. - Example 2: Mitigate the risks. - Synonyms: alleviate, ease - Antonyms: exacerbate - 💡 Memory tip: הנגדי של exacerbate. ### 2158. alleviate (v.) - Definition: to make pain or difficulty less - תרגום: להקל - Example 1: Medicine alleviates pain. - Example 2: Policies to alleviate poverty. - Synonyms: ease, mitigate, relieve - 💡 Memory tip: הקלת סבל או קושי. ### 2159. ameliorate (v.) - Definition: to improve - תרגום: לשפר - Example 1: Ameliorate the conditions. - Example 2: Efforts to ameliorate the crisis. - Synonyms: improve, enhance - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי ואקדמי מאוד. ### 2160. obfuscate (v.) - Definition: to make unclear - תרגום: לטשטש, לערפל - Example 1: Don't obfuscate the truth. - Example 2: Politicians often obfuscate issues. - Synonyms: confuse, obscure - Antonyms: clarify, elucidate - 💡 Memory tip: להפוך לעמום במכוון. ### 2161. elucidate - already covered at #1523. ### 2161. disparage (v.) - Definition: to speak badly of - תרגום: לזלזל, להשמיץ - Example 1: Don't disparage others. - Example 2: She was disparaged publicly. - Synonyms: belittle, criticize - Antonyms: praise, extol - 💡 Memory tip: dis- = נגד. ### 2162. denigrate (v.) - Definition: to criticize unfairly - תרגום: להשמיץ - Example 1: Don't denigrate his work. - Example 2: Denigrating comments. - Synonyms: disparage, defame - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי - התקפה על שם. ### 2163. vilify (v.) - Definition: to speak evil of - תרגום: להכפיש - Example 1: The media vilified him. - Example 2: Vilified for his actions. - Synonyms: denigrate, defame - 💡 Memory tip: מ-vile (נבזה). ### 2164. lambaste (v.) - Definition: to criticize harshly - תרגום: לגנות בחריפות - Example 1: Critics lambasted the decision. - Example 2: He was lambasted in the press. - Synonyms: berate, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ועיתונאי. ### 2165. berate (v.) - Definition: to scold angrily - תרגום: לנזוף בזעם - Example 1: She berated him for lying. - Example 2: Don't berate yourself. - Synonyms: scold, reproach - 💡 Memory tip: נזיפה חזקה. ### 2166. reproach (v.) - Definition: to express disappointment - תרגום: להטיל אשמה, להוכיח - Example 1: She reproached him gently. - Example 2: I reproach myself. - Synonyms: rebuke, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת עדינה יותר. ### 2167. repudiate (v.) - Definition: to refuse to accept - תרגום: לדחות, להתנער מ- - Example 1: Repudiate the accusations. - Example 2: He repudiated his earlier statements. - Synonyms: reject, renounce - 💡 Memory tip: דחייה פומבית ורשמית. ### 2168. reconcile - already covered. ### 2168. assuage (v.) - Definition: to make less intense - תרגום: להרגיע, לפייס - Example 1: Assuage her fears. - Example 2: Nothing could assuage his grief. - Synonyms: ease, calm - 💡 Memory tip: להרגיע רגשות חזקים. ### 2169.

Example 2: A vexing problem. - Synonyms: annoy, trouble - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - הטרדה מתמשכת. ### 2170. placate - already covered in Package 4. ### 2170. galvanize (v.) - Definition: to shock into action - תרגום: לחשמל, לעורר לפעולה - Example 1: The speech galvanized the crowd. - Example 2: Galvanize supporters. - Synonyms: energize, inspire - 💡 Memory tip: מגלוון = מחשמל. ### 2171. mollify (v.) - Definition: to soothe anger - תרגום: לרכך, לפייס - Example 1: Tried to mollify her anger. - Example 2: His apology mollified them. - Synonyms: appease, placate - 💡 Memory tip: הרגעה של זעם. ### 2172. exonerate (v.) - Definition: to clear from blame - תרגום: לזכות מאשמה - Example 1: Evidence exonerated him. - Example 2: The court exonerated her. - Synonyms: acquit, absolve - Antonyms: convict, blame - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי - זיכוי. ### 2173. absolve (v.) - Definition: to declare free from guilt - תרגום: לזכות - Example 1: Absolved of all charges. - Example 2: The priest absolved his sins. - Synonyms: exonerate, pardon - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי ודתי. ### 2174. impugn (v.) - Definition: to challenge the truth of - תרגום: להטיל ספק ב- - Example 1: Impugn his integrity. - Example 2: Don't impugn her motives. - Synonyms: challenge, question - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד - משפטי. ### 2175. extrapolate (v.) - Definition: to estimate beyond known data - תרגום: להסיק/לאמוד - Example 1: Extrapolate from the data. - Example 2: Extrapolate future trends. - Synonyms: infer, project - 💡 Memory tip: מ-extra + data. ### 2176. interpolate (v.) - Definition: to insert between existing elements - תרגום: לשלב, להוסיף בין - Example 1: Interpolate new data points. - Example 2: Comments were interpolated. - Synonyms: insert - 💡 Memory tip: מתמטי ולינגוויסטי. ### 2177. expound - already covered at #1524. ### 2177. pontificate - already covered. ### 2177. equivocate (v.) - Definition: to speak ambiguously to avoid committing - תרגום: להתחמק בדיבור - Example 1: Don't equivocate - answer! - Example 2: Politicians equivocate often. - Synonyms: hedge, prevaricate - 💡 Memory tip: להימנע מהתחייבות ברורה. ### 2178. prevaricate (v.) - Definition: to avoid telling the truth - תרגום: להתחמק, לפזל - Example 1: Stop prevaricating! - Example 2: He prevaricated about his past. - Synonyms: equivocate, lie - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי. ### 2179. dissemble (v.) - Definition: to conceal one's true motives - תרגום: להסוות - Example 1: She dissembled her feelings. - Example 2: Dissembling his intentions. - Synonyms: pretend, conceal - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - להסתיר כוונות. ### 2180. procrastinate (v.) - Definition: to delay doing - תרגום: לדחות, להתמהמה - Example 1: Don't procrastinate - act now! - Example 2: He procrastinates constantly. - Synonyms: delay, postpone - 💡 Memory tip: נפוץ - דחיינות. --- # 🎩 קטגוריה 2: שמות עצם נדירים ומתוחכמים (30 מילים) ### 2181. zeitgeist (n.) - Definition: the spirit of the times - תרגום: רוח הזמן - Example 1: The zeitgeist of the 1960s. - Example 2: She captures the zeitgeist. - Synonyms: spirit of the age - 💡 Memory tip: מגרמנית - מופיע באנגלית מלומדת. ### 2182. sycophant (n.) - Definition: a person who flatters for gain - תרגום: חנפן - Example 1: Surrounded by sycophants. - Example 2: A sycophant has no real opinions. - Synonyms: flatterer, toady - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי מאוד. ### 2183. charlatan (n.) - Definition: a fake expert - תרגום: שרלטן - Example 1: A charlatan claiming to heal. - Example 2: Avoid charlatans online. - Synonyms: fraud, impostor - 💡 Memory tip: מזויף המתחזה למומחה. ### 2184. demagogue (n.) - Definition: a politician who appeals to emotions - תרגום: דמגוג - Example 1: A dangerous demagogue. - Example 2: Demagogues exploit fears. - Synonyms: rabble-rouser - 💡 Memory tip: מיוונית - מוביל העם (בשלילה). ### 2185. iconoclast (n.) - Definition: a person who attacks established beliefs - תרגום: שובר מוסכמות - Example 1: She's an intellectual iconoclast. - Example 2: Artistic iconoclasts. - Synonyms: nonconformist, rebel - 💡 Memory tip: שובר אליל (מיוונית). ### 2186. pariah (n.) - Definition: an outcast - תרגום: מנודה - Example 1: Treated as a social pariah. - Example 2: A political pariah. - Synonyms: outcast, untouchable - 💡 Memory tip: מהודית - ספרותי ועיתונאי. ### 2187. doyen (n.) - Definition: the most respected member - תרגום: הבכיר - Example 1: The doyen of physicists. - Example 2: He's the doyen of his field. - Synonyms: dean, senior - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית. ### 2188. maverick (n.) - Definition: a non-conformist - תרגום: עצמאי מאוד, מורד - Example 1: A political maverick. - Example 2: Known as a maverick. - Synonyms: individualist, nonconformist - 💡 Memory tip: מיוחד במינו. ### 2189. neophyte (n.) - Definition: a beginner - תרגום: מתחיל, טירון - Example 1: A neophyte in programming. - Example 2: Neophytes welcome. - Synonyms: beginner, novice - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ויפה. ### 2190. connoisseur (n.) - Definition: an expert judge - תרגום: מבין, מומחה (בטעם) - Example 1: A wine connoisseur. - Example 2: An art connoisseur. - Synonyms: expert, authority - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - איות מסובך. ### 2191. savant (n.) - Definition: a learned person - תרגום: מלומד - Example 1: A scientific savant. - Example 2: Musical savant. - Synonyms: scholar, genius - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - "מי שיודע". ### 2192. polymath (n.) - Definition: a person of wide knowledge - תרגום: איש אשכולות - Example 1: Da Vinci was a polymath. - Example 2: A true polymath. - Synonyms: scholar, Renaissance man - 💡 Memory tip: poly- (רב) + math (למידה). ### 2193. raconteur (n.) - Definition: a skilled storyteller - תרגום: מספר סיפורים מוכשר - Example 1: A brilliant raconteur. - Example 2: Known as a great raconteur. - Synonyms: storyteller - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית. ### 2194. pundit (n.) - Definition: an expert giving opinions - Synonyms: berate, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ועיתונאי. ### 2165. berate (v.) - Definition: to scold angrily - תרגום: לנזוף בזעם - Example 1: She berated him for lying. - Example 2: Don't berate yourself. - Synonyms: scold, reproach - 💡 Memory tip: נזיפה חזקה. ### 2166. reproach (v.) - Definition: to express disappointment - תרגום: להטיל אשמה, להוכיח - Example 1: She reproached him gently. - Example 2: I reproach myself. - Synonyms: rebuke, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת עדינה יותר. ### 2167. repudiate (v.) - Definition: to refuse to accept - תרגום: לדחות, להתנער מ- - Example 1: Repudiate the accusations. - Example 2: He repudiated his earlier statements. - Synonyms: reject, renounce - 💡 Memory tip: דחייה פומבית ורשמית. ### 2168. reconcile - already covered. ### 2168. assuage (v.) - Definition: to make less intense - תרגום: להרגיע, לפייס - Example 1: Assuage her fears. - Example 2: Nothing could assuage his grief. - Synonyms: ease, calm - 💡 Memory tip: להרגיע רגשות חזקים. ### 2169. vex (v.) - Definition: to annoy or worry - תרגום: להרגיז - Example 1: The noise vexed him. - Example 2: A vexing problem. - Synonyms: annoy, trouble - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - הטרדה מתמשכת. ### 2170. placate - already covered in Package 4. ### 2170. galvanize (v.) - Definition: to shock into action - תרגום: לחשמל, לעורר לפעולה - Example 1: The speech galvanized the crowd. - Example 2: Galvanize supporters. - Synonyms: energize, inspire - 💡 Memory tip: מגלוון = מחשמל. ### 2171. mollify (v.) - Definition: to soothe anger - תרגום: לרכך, לפייס - Example 1: Tried to mollify her anger. - Example 2: His apology mollified them. - Synonyms: appease, placate - 💡 Memory tip: הרגעה של זעם. ### 2172. exonerate (v.) - Definition: to clear from blame - תרגום: לזכות מאשמה - Example 1: Evidence exonerated him. - Example 2: The court exonerated her. - Synonyms: acquit, absolve - Antonyms: convict, blame - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי - זיכוי. ### 2173. absolve (v.) - Definition: to declare free from guilt - תרגום: לזכות - Example 1: Absolved of all charges. - Example 2: The priest absolved his sins. - Synonyms: exonerate, pardon - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי ודתי. ### 2174. impugn (v.) - Definition: to challenge the truth of - תרגום: להטיל ספק ב- - Example 1: Impugn his integrity. - Example 2: Don't impugn her motives. - Synonyms: challenge, question - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד - משפטי. ### 2175. extrapolate (v.) - Definition: to estimate beyond known data - תרגום: להסיק/לאמוד - Example 1: Extrapolate from the data. - Example 2: Extrapolate future trends. - Synonyms: infer, project - 💡 Memory tip: מ-extra + data. ### 2176. interpolate (v.) - Definition: to insert between existing elements - תרגום: לשלב, להוסיף בין - Example 1: Interpolate new data points. - Example 2: Comments were interpolated. - Synonyms: insert - 💡 Memory tip: מתמטי ולינגוויסטי. ### 2177. expound - already covered at #1524. ### 2177. pontificate - already covered. ### 2177. equivocate (v.) - Definition: to speak ambiguously to avoid committing - תרגום: להתחמק בדיבור - Example 1: Don't equivocate - answer! - Example 2: Politicians equivocate often. - Synonyms: hedge, prevaricate - 💡 Memory tip: להימנע מהתחייבות ברורה. ### 2178. prevaricate (v.) - Definition: to avoid telling the truth - תרגום: להתחמק, לפזל - Example 1: Stop prevaricating! - Example 2: He prevaricated about his past. - Synonyms: equivocate, lie - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי. ### 2179. dissemble (v.) - Definition: to conceal one's true motives - תרגום: להסוות - Example 1: She dissembled her feelings. - Example 2: Dissembling his intentions. - Synonyms: pretend, conceal - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - להסתיר כוונות. ### 2180. procrastinate (v.) - Definition: to delay doing - תרגום: לדחות, להתמהמה - Example 1: Don't procrastinate - act now! - Example 2: He procrastinates constantly. - Synonyms: delay, postpone - 💡 Memory tip: נפוץ - דחיינות. --- # 🎩 קטגוריה 2: שמות עצם נדירים ומתוחכמים (30 מילים) ### 2181. zeitgeist (n.) - Definition: the spirit of the times - תרגום: רוח הזמן - Example 1: The zeitgeist of the 1960s. - Example 2: She captures the zeitgeist. - Synonyms: spirit of the age - 💡 Memory tip: מגרמנית - מופיע באנגלית מלומדת. ### 2182. sycophant (n.) - Definition: a person who flatters for gain - תרגום: חנפן - Example 1: Surrounded by sycophants. - Example 2: A sycophant has no real opinions. - Synonyms: flatterer, toady - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי מאוד. ### 2183. charlatan (n.) - Definition: a fake expert - תרגום: שרלטן - Example 1: A charlatan claiming to heal. - Example 2: Avoid charlatans online. - Synonyms: fraud, impostor - 💡 Memory tip: מזויף המתחזה למומחה. ### 2184. demagogue (n.) - Definition: a politician who appeals to emotions - תרגום: דמגוג - Example 1: A dangerous demagogue. - Example 2: Demagogues exploit fears. - Synonyms: rabble-rouser - 💡 Memory tip: מיוונית - מוביל העם (בשלילה). ### 2185. iconoclast (n.) - Definition: a person who attacks established beliefs - תרגום: שובר מוסכמות - Example 1: She's an intellectual iconoclast. - Example 2: Artistic iconoclasts. - Synonyms: nonconformist, rebel - 💡 Memory tip: שובר אליל (מיוונית). ### 2186. pariah (n.) - Definition: an outcast - תרגום: מנודה - Example 1: Treated as a social pariah. - Example 2: A political pariah. - Synonyms: outcast, untouchable - 💡 Memory tip: מהודית - ספרותי ועיתונאי. ### 2187. doyen (n.) - Definition: the most respected member - תרגום: הבכיר - Example 1: The doyen of physicists. - Example 2: He's the doyen of his field. - Synonyms: dean, senior - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית. ### 2188. maverick (n.) - Definition: a non-conformist - תרגום: עצמאי מאוד, מורד - Example 1: A political maverick. - Example 2: Known as a maverick. - Synonyms: individualist, nonconformist - 💡 Memory tip: מיוחד במינו. ### 2189. neophyte (n.) - Definition: a beginner - תרגום: מתחיל, טירון - Example 1: A neophyte in programming. - Example 2: Neophytes welcome. - Synonyms: beginner, novice - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ויפה. ### 2190. connoisseur (n.) - Definition: an expert judge - תרגום: מבין, מומחה (בטעם) - Example 1: A wine connoisseur. - Example 2: An art connoisseur. - Synonyms: expert, authority - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - איות מסובך. ### 2191. savant (n.) - Definition: a learned person - תרגום: מלומד - Example 1: A scientific savant. - Example 2: Musical savant. - Synonyms: scholar, genius - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - "מי שיודע". ### 2192. polymath (n.) - Definition: a person of wide knowledge - תרגום: איש אשכולות - Example 1: Da Vinci was a polymath. - Example 2: A true polymath. - Synonyms: scholar, Renaissance man - 💡 Memory tip: poly- (רב) + math (למידה). ### 2193. raconteur (n.) - Definition: a skilled storyteller - תרגום: מספר סיפורים מוכשר - Example 1: A brilliant raconteur. - Example 2: Known as a great raconteur. - Synonyms: storyteller - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית. ### 2194. pundit (n.) - Definition: an expert giving opinions - תרגום: פרשן, מומחה - Example 1: Political pundits. - Example 2: A media pundit. - Synonyms: expert, commentator - 💡 Memory tip: מהודית. ### 2195. epithet (n.) - Definition: a descriptive word or phrase - תרגום: כינוי, תואר - Example 1: An insulting epithet. - Example 2: Her epithet was "Iron Lady". - Synonyms: nickname, title - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי מאוד. ### 2196. euphemism (n.) - Definition: a mild word replacing a harsh one - תרגום: לשון נקייה - Example 1: "Passed away" is a euphemism. - Example 2: A corporate euphemism. - Synonyms: polite term - 💡 Memory tip: eu- = טוב. ### 2197. hyperbole (n.) - Definition: exaggeration - תרגום: הגזמה - Example 1: "I could eat a horse" is hyperbole. - Example 2: Advertising uses hyperbole. - Synonyms: exaggeration - 💡 Memory tip: סגנון ספרותי. ### 2198. oxymoron (n.) - Definition: a figure of speech combining opposites - תרגום: אוקסימורון - Example 1: "Deafening silence" is an oxymoron. - Example 2: "Jumbo shrimp" is an oxymoron. - Synonyms: contradiction - 💡 Memory tip: שילוב של הפכים. ### 2199. cacophony (n.) - Definition: a harsh sound - contentBlocks.title: Overview
contentBlocks.body: # Connectives מתקדמים – 50 מילות קישור נוספות ## חבילה נוספת לקורס - מילות קישור אקדמיות מתקדמות מבנה: 50 מילות קישור חיוניות שלא נכללו בחבילות הקודמות - לכתיבה ולהבנה אקדמית חשיבות: מילות קישור הן "הדבק" של כתיבה אקדמית. הן מראות את הקשרים הלוגיים בין רעיונות ומשפרות מאוד את רמת האנגלית. --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. קישורי הוספה (2101-2110) - 10 מילים 2. קישורי ניגוד (2111-2120) - 10 מילים 3. קישורי סיבה ותוצאה (2121-2130) - 10 מילים 4. קישורי דוגמה וסיכום (2131-2140) - 10 מילים 5. קישורי זמן ורצף (2141-2150) - 10 מילים --- # ➕ קטגוריה 1: קישורי הוספה (10 מילים) ### 2101. in addition (phrase) - Definition: also; as well - תרגום: בנוסף - Example 1: In addition, we need more funds. - Example 2: She's smart, in addition to being talented. - Synonyms: furthermore, moreover - 💡 Memory tip: להוספת מידע. ### 2102. additionally (adv.) - Definition: in addition; also - תרגום: בנוסף לכך - Example 1: Additionally, there are risks. - Example 2: Additionally, we must consider cost. - Synonyms: moreover, furthermore - 💡 Memory tip: מ-additional. ### 2103. not only... but also (phrase) - Definition: both X and Y - תרגום: לא רק... אלא גם - Example 1: She's not only smart but also kind. - Example 2: Not only does it work, but it also saves money. - Synonyms: both...and - 💡 Memory tip: בסדר קבוע: not only + fact 1, but also + fact 2. ### 2104. as well as (conj.) - Definition: in addition to - תרגום: כמו גם - Example 1: English, as well as Hebrew, is taught. - Example 2: He plays tennis as well as basketball. - Synonyms: and, along with - 💡 Memory tip: להוספה עם השוואה. ### 2105. along with (prep.) - Definition: together with - תרגום: יחד עם - Example 1: Send the form along with payment. - Example 2: Along with others, she voted. - Synonyms: together with - 💡 Memory tip: צירוף יחד. ### 21
